package com.myapp.adventure.ui

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import com.myapp.adventure.data.StepBucket
import com.myapp.adventure.databinding.FragmentStatisticsBinding
import com.myapp.adventure.databinding.ItemStatsDayBinding
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.FontManager
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.StepHistoryManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.text.NumberFormat
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.time.format.FormatStyle
import java.time.format.TextStyle
import java.util.Locale

class StatisticsFragment : Fragment() {

    private var _binding: FragmentStatisticsBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!

    /** First rank threshold (visual only; actual reward logic is future). */
    private val firstRankThreshold: Long = 100_000L

    /** Cached number formatter, recreated if locale changes between onViewCreated calls. */
    private var numberFormat: NumberFormat = NumberFormat.getIntegerInstance(Locale.getDefault())

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentStatisticsBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val fontName = FontManager.getSelectedFont(requireContext())
        FontManager.applyFontToViewTree(view, fontName, requireContext())

        numberFormat = NumberFormat.getIntegerInstance(Locale.getDefault())

        binding.btnMenu.setOnClickListener {
            parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                .replace(R.id.fragment_container, MenuFragment())
                .addToBackStack(null)
                .commit()
        }

        loadStats()
    }

    // ==================== Loading ====================

    private fun loadStats() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        binding.tvLoading.visibility = View.VISIBLE

        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            val data = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                val ctx = requireContext().applicationContext
                StatisticsData(
                    total = StepHistoryManager.getTotalSteps(ctx),
                    today = StepHistoryManager.getTodaySteps(ctx),
                    last7 = StepHistoryManager.getLastNDaysSum(ctx, 7),
                    last30 = StepHistoryManager.getLastNDaysSum(ctx, 30),
                    days = StepHistoryManager.getDailyBuckets(ctx, 14)
                )
            }
            if (_binding == null) return@launch
            binding.tvLoading.visibility = View.GONE
            render(data)
        }
    }

    private data class StatisticsData(
        val total: Long,
        val today: Int,
        val last7: Int,
        val last30: Int,
        val days: List<StepBucket>
    )

    // ==================== Render ====================

    private fun render(data: StatisticsData) {
        if (_binding == null) return

        val hasPermission = hasActivityRecognitionPermission()

        // 1. No permission warning
        binding.tvNoPermission.visibility = if (!hasPermission) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE

        // 2. No data placeholder
        val hasData = data.total > 0L || data.days.any { it.steps > 0 }
        binding.tvNoData.visibility = if (!hasData) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE

        // 3. Summary / recent / days sections only when there's data
        val sectionsVisibility = if (hasData) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        binding.sectionSummary.visibility = sectionsVisibility
        binding.sectionRecent.visibility = sectionsVisibility
        binding.sectionDays.visibility = sectionsVisibility

        if (!hasData) return

        // Total
        binding.tvTotalSteps.text = formatSteps(data.total)

        // Rank progress (visual only for now)
        renderRankProgress(data.total)

        // Today / 7 / 30
        binding.tvTodaySteps.text =
            "${getString(R.string.stats_today)}: ${formatSteps(data.today.toLong())}"
        binding.tvLast7DaysSteps.text =
            "${getString(R.string.stats_last_7_days)}: ${formatSteps(data.last7.toLong())}"
        binding.tvLast30DaysSteps.text =
            "${getString(R.string.stats_last_30_days)}: ${formatSteps(data.last30.toLong())}"

        // 14-day list
        renderDays(data.days)
    }

    private fun renderRankProgress(total: Long) {
        val threshold = firstRankThreshold
        val progress: Int
        val progressText: String
        if (total >= threshold) {
            progress = 100
            progressText = getString(
                R.string.stats_rank_achieved,
                getString(R.string.stats_rank_beginner)
            )
            binding.tvRankProgress.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
        } else {
            progress = ((total * 100L) / threshold).toInt().coerceIn(0, 100)
            progressText = getString(
                R.string.stats_rank_progress,
                progress,
                getString(R.string.stats_rank_beginner)
            )
            binding.tvRankProgress.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFC107"))
        }
        binding.progressRank.progress = progress
        binding.tvRankProgress.text = progressText
    }

    private fun renderDays(days: List<StepBucket>) {
        binding.containerDays.removeAllViews()

        val today = LocalDate.now()
        val dateFormatter = DateTimeFormatter
            .ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.MEDIUM)
            .withLocale(Locale.getDefault())
        val locale = Locale.getDefault()

        // Oldest at the top, newest at the bottom (matches reading order of a timeline).
        for (bucket in days) {
            val date = try {
                LocalDate.parse(bucket.date)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                continue
            }

            val row = ItemStatsDayBinding.inflate(
                LayoutInflater.from(requireContext()),
                binding.containerDays,
                false
            )

            val dayOfWeek = date.dayOfWeek.getDisplayName(TextStyle.SHORT, locale)
            val isToday = date == today
            val dateLabel = if (isToday) {
                "${dateFormatter.format(date)} · ${getString(R.string.stats_today).lowercase(locale)}"
            } else {
                "$dayOfWeek, ${dateFormatter.format(date)}"
            }

            row.tvDayLabel.text = dateLabel
            row.tvDaySteps.text = formatSteps(bucket.steps.toLong())
            // Dim days with zero steps so they don't dominate the screen.
            row.tvDaySteps.setTextColor(
                if (bucket.steps == 0) Color.parseColor("#666666")
                else Color.parseColor("#FFC107")
            )

            binding.containerDays.addView(row.root)
        }
    }

    // ==================== Helpers ====================

    private fun formatSteps(value: Long): String {
        val formattedNumber = numberFormat.format(value)
        // Use plurals with the raw count so Android picks the right form.
        val stepsText = resources.getQuantityString(
            R.plurals.steps,
            value.toInt(),
            value.toInt()
        )
        // We only want the plural form word ("шаг"/"шага"/"шагов"), not the formatted number.
        // The plural string starts with "%d" — strip it.
        val suffix = stepsText.replace(value.toString(), "").trim()
        return "$formattedNumber $suffix"
    }

    private fun hasActivityRecognitionPermission(): Boolean {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) return true
        return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
            requireContext(),
            Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}

class AdventureEditorFragment : Fragment() {

    private lateinit var initialStateAdapter: InitialStateAdapter

    private val debounceHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var hasUnsavedChanges = false
    private var menuExpanded = false

    private val saveRunnable = Runnable { saveDraftImmediate() }

    private val openFileLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()
    ) { uri: Uri? ->
        if (uri != null) loadFromUri(uri)
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        viewModel = ViewModelProvider(requireActivity()).get(AdventureEditorViewModel::class.java)

        val dirtyCallback: (Boolean) -> Unit = { structural ->
            if (structural) viewModel.commitSnapshot()
            markDirty()
        }

        adapter = EditorSceneAdapter(
            viewModel = viewModel,
            onDirty = dirtyCallback,
            onPreview = { uid -> openPreview(uid) }
        )
        initialStateAdapter = InitialStateAdapter(viewModel, dirtyCallback)
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentAdventureEditorBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        applyWindowInsetsToRoot(view)

        binding.rvScenes.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())

        val concatAdapter = ConcatAdapter(initialStateAdapter, adapter)
        binding.rvScenes.adapter = concatAdapter

        binding.rvScenes.setItemViewCacheSize(15)
        binding.rvScenes.itemAnimator = null

        binding.btnMenu.setOnClickListener {
            parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                .replace(R.id.fragment_container, MenuFragment())
                .addToBackStack(null)
                .commit()
        }
        binding.btnToggleMenu.setOnClickListener { toggleMenu() }

        binding.btnUndo.setOnClickListener { performUndo() }
        binding.btnRedo.setOnClickListener { performRedo() }
        binding.btnAddScene.setOnClickListener {
            viewModel.addScene()
            viewModel.commitSnapshot()
            markDirty()
            adapter.submitList()
            binding.rvScenes.post {
                if (_binding != null) {
                    // +1 — сдвиг на позицию InitialStateAdapter (всегда первый)
                    binding.rvScenes.scrollToPosition(viewModel.scenes.size)
                }
            }
        }
        binding.btnSave.setOnClickListener { saveAdventure() }
        binding.btnLoad.setOnClickListener { openFileLauncher.launch(arrayOf("application/json")) }
        binding.btnEditMeta.setOnClickListener { openEditMetaDialog() }

        binding.btnSearch.setOnClickListener { showSearchDialog() }
        binding.btnStats.setOnClickListener { showStatsDialog() }

                .addToBackStack(null)
                .commit()

            ?.initialPrefetchItemCount = 4

        adapter.submitList()
        updateTitleField()
        updateUndoRedoButtons()

        maybeRestoreDraft()

        if (!viewModel.isHistoryInitialized()) {
            viewModel.initHistory()
            updateUndoRedoButtons()
        }

        // Если редактор открывается после возврата из карты
        val pending = viewModel.pendingJumpToSceneUid
        if (pending != null) {
            viewModel.pendingJumpToSceneUid = null
            binding.rvScenes.post { jumpToScene(pending) }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        val pending = viewModel.pendingJumpToSceneUid
        if (pending != null && _binding != null) {
            viewModel.pendingJumpToSceneUid = null
            jumpToScene(pending)
        }
    }

    private fun applyWindowInsetsToRoot(view: View) {
        ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(view) { v, insets ->
            val topInset = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.statusBars()).top
            v.setPadding(0, topInset, 0, 0)
            insets
        }
    }

    // ---------- Toolbar ----------

    private fun toggleMenu() {
        menuExpanded = !menuExpanded
        binding.menuActions.visibility = if (menuExpanded) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
    }

    private fun updateTitleField() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        binding.tvAdventureTitle.text = viewModel.title.ifBlank { "Без названия" }
    }

    private fun updateUndoRedoButtons() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        val undoEnabled = viewModel.canUndo() || (hasUnsavedChanges && viewModel.isHistoryInitialized())
        val redoEnabled = viewModel.canRedo()
        binding.btnUndo.isEnabled = undoEnabled
        binding.btnUndo.alpha = if (undoEnabled) 1f else 0.4f
        binding.btnRedo.isEnabled = redoEnabled
        binding.btnRedo.alpha = if (redoEnabled) 1f else 0.4f
    }

    // ---------- Редактирование названия ----------

    private fun openEditMetaDialog() {
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.dialog_edit_meta, null)
        val etTitle = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.et_meta_title)
        val etAuthor = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.et_meta_author)
        val etDesc = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.et_meta_description)

        etTitle.setText(viewModel.title)
        etAuthor.setText(viewModel.author)
        etDesc.setText(viewModel.description)

        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Редактировать приключение")
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton("Применить") { _, _ ->
                viewModel.title = etTitle.text.toString().trim()
                viewModel.author = etAuthor.text.toString().trim()
                viewModel.description = etDesc.text.toString().trim()
                updateTitleField()
                markDirty()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Отмена", null)
            .show()
    }

    // ---------- Undo / Redo ----------

    private fun performUndo() {
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        if (hasUnsavedChanges) viewModel.commitSnapshot()
        if (!viewModel.undo()) return
        saveDraftImmediate()
        refreshAfterHistoryChange()
    }

    private fun performRedo() {
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        if (!viewModel.redo()) return
        saveDraftImmediate()
        refreshAfterHistoryChange()
    }

    private fun refreshAfterHistoryChange() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        adapter.submitList()
        initialStateAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
        updateTitleField()
        updateUndoRedoButtons()
    }

    // ---------- Debounce-автосохранение ----------

    private fun markDirty() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        hasUnsavedChanges = true
        binding.tvSaveStatus.text = "Изменения…"
        binding.tvSaveStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFC107"))
        updateUndoRedoButtons()
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        debounceHandler.postDelayed(saveRunnable, DEBOUNCE_MS)
    }

    private fun saveDraftImmediate() {
        if (_binding == null) return
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        binding.tvSaveStatus.text = "Сохранение…"
        binding.tvSaveStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#9E9E9E"))

        viewModel.commitSnapshot()
        EditorDraftManager.saveDraft(
            requireContext(),
            viewModel.title,
            viewModel.author,
            viewModel.description,
            viewModel.initialStateTags,
            viewModel.scenes
        )
        hasUnsavedChanges = false
        binding.tvSaveStatus.text = "Сохранено"
        binding.tvSaveStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
        updateUndoRedoButtons()
        Logger.log(requireContext(), "Черновик автосохранён, сцен: ${viewModel.scenes.size}")
    }

    // ---------- Восстановление черновика ----------

    private fun maybeRestoreDraft() {
        if (viewModel.scenes.isNotEmpty() ||
            viewModel.title.isNotEmpty() ||
            viewModel.author.isNotEmpty() ||
            viewModel.description.isNotEmpty() ||
            viewModel.initialStateTags.isNotEmpty()
        ) return

        val draft = EditorDraftManager.loadDraft(requireContext()) ?: return
        if (draft.scenes.isEmpty() && draft.title.isEmpty() && draft.initialStateTags.isEmpty()) {
            EditorDraftManager.clearDraft(requireContext())
            return
        }

        val dateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("d MMMM, HH:mm", Locale.getDefault())
        val draftDateStr = dateFormat.format(Date(draft.savedAt))

        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Восстановить черновик?")
            .setMessage(
                "Найден несохранённый черновик от $draftDateStr\n" +
                        "Сцен: ${draft.scenes.size}\n\n" +
                        "Восстановить?"
            )
            .setPositiveButton("Восстановить") { _, _ ->
                viewModel.title = draft.title
                viewModel.author = draft.author
                viewModel.description = draft.description
                viewModel.initialStateTags.clear()
                viewModel.initialStateTags.addAll(draft.initialStateTags.map { it.copy() })
                viewModel.scenes.clear()
                viewModel.scenes.addAll(draft.scenes.map { it.deepCopy() })

                viewModel.initHistory()
                viewModel.collapseAllScenes()
                viewModel.collapseAllChoices()

                adapter.submitList()
                initialStateAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
                updateTitleField()
                updateUndoRedoButtons()

                hasUnsavedChanges = false
                binding.tvSaveStatus.text = "Сохранено"
                binding.tvSaveStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
                Logger.log(requireContext(), "Черновик восстановлен, сцен: ${draft.scenes.size}")
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Удалить") { _, _ ->
                EditorDraftManager.clearDraft(requireContext())
            }
            .show()
    }

    // ---------- Загрузка из файла ----------

    private fun loadFromUri(uri: Uri) {
        try {
            val inputStream = requireContext().contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
            val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(inputStream))
            val json = reader.readText()
            reader.close()
            val adventure = Gson().fromJson(json, Adventure::class.java)

            debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
            EditorDraftManager.clearDraft(requireContext())
            hasUnsavedChanges = false

            viewModel.title = adventure.title
            viewModel.author = adventure.author
            viewModel.description = adventure.description
            viewModel.scenes.clear()

            val tagDefs = adventure.tags.orEmpty().associateBy { it.name }

            // Восстанавливаем initialStateTags из adventure.initialState
            viewModel.initialStateTags.clear()
            val init = adventure.initialState
            if (init != null) {
                init.flags?.forEach { flag ->
                    val def = tagDefs[flag]
                    viewModel.initialStateTags.add(
                        EditorTag(
                            name = flag,
                            value = 0,
                            isStatModifier = false,
                            category = def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL,
                            displayName = def?.displayName ?: flag,
                            visible = def?.visible ?: false
                        )
                    )
                }
                init.stats?.forEach { (name, value) ->
                    val def = tagDefs[name]
                    val cat = def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL
                    viewModel.initialStateTags.add(
                        EditorTag(
                            name = name,
                            value = value,
                            isStatModifier = true,
                            category = cat,
                            displayName = def?.displayName ?: name,
                            visible = def?.visible ?: false
                        )
                    )
                }
            }

            // b2: per-scene gate + chapter-boundary as two independent
            // concepts.
            //
            // Reading order: scenes are grouped into chapters exactly as
            // before (`chapter.scenes`). Within a chapter, the **last**
            // scene is marked as the narrative chapter boundary
            // (`isChapterEnd = true`) — this is what the map / stats /
            // validator use for grouping and the "🏁 Конец главы" badge.
            //
            // The gate is now a **scene property** (`scene.gate` in v5
            // JSON), not a chapter property. For files that predate v5
            // (no `scene.gate`, but `chapter.required_steps` present on
            // the *next* chapter), we migrate: the legacy v1 gate on
            // `chapter[i+1]` becomes `gateRequiredSteps` on the last
            // scene of chapter `i`. Same migration `JsonToIr.parse`
            // does — kept here so the editor sees the same data before
            // and after the "load → save" round-trip.
            val allChapters = adventure.chapters.orEmpty()
            for ((chapterIndex, chapter) in allChapters.withIndex()) {
                val scenes = chapter.scenes.orEmpty()
                // v1 migration: `chapter[i+1].required_steps` → gate on
                // the last scene of chapter `i`. `null` (field absent)
                // and `0` both mean "no gate".
                val v1GateForLastScene =
                    allChapters.getOrNull(chapterIndex + 1)?.requiredSteps ?: 0
                for ((sceneIndex, scene) in scenes.withIndex()) {
                    val isLastInChapter = sceneIndex == scenes.lastIndex
                    val v5Gate = scene.gate ?: 0
                    val effectiveGate =
                        if (v5Gate > 0) v5Gate
                        else if (isLastInChapter) v1GateForLastScene
                        else 0
                    val editorScene = EditorScene(
                        id = scene.id,
                        idIsAuto = false,
                        title = scene.id,
                        text = scene.text,
                        isChapterEnd = isLastInChapter,
                        gateRequiredSteps = effectiveGate,
                        gateRepeatable = scene.gateRepeatable ?: false,
                        // Ф1.7.5: read `"is_ending"` from the JSON.
                        // `:app/data/Scene.isEnding` is nullable
                        // (absent on pre-v4 files, or on files the
                        // editor itself writes without the flag);
                        // map `null` to `false` — the same identity
                        // migration that `JsonToIr` applies.
                        isEnding = scene.isEnding ?: false,
                        tags = extractTags(scene, tagDefs),
                        choices = scene.choices?.map { choice ->
                            EditorChoice(
                                text = choice.text,
                                nextSceneId = choice.nextScene,
                                conditionTag = choice.condition ?: "",
                                tags = extractChoiceTags(choice, tagDefs)
                            )
                        }?.toMutableList() ?: mutableListOf()
                    )
                    viewModel.scenes.add(editorScene)
                }
            }

            // Восстанавливаем сцену смерти из adventure.deathScene
            val deathDef = adventure.deathScene
            if (deathDef != null) {
                val existingScene = viewModel.scenes.find { it.id == deathDef.id }
                if (existingScene != null) {
                    existingScene.isDeathScene = true
                    existingScene.deathAllowStepBack = deathDef.allowStepBack
                    existingScene.deathAllowChapterRestart = deathDef.allowChapterRestart
                    existingScene.deathAllowAdventureRestart = deathDef.allowAdventureRestart
                } else {
                    val deathSceneEditor = EditorScene(
                        id = deathDef.id,
                        idIsAuto = false,
                        title = "Сцена смерти",
                        text = deathDef.text,
                        isDeathScene = true,
                        deathAllowStepBack = deathDef.allowStepBack,
                        deathAllowChapterRestart = deathDef.allowChapterRestart,
                        deathAllowAdventureRestart = deathDef.allowAdventureRestart
                    )
                    viewModel.scenes.add(deathSceneEditor)
                }
            }

            viewModel.initHistory()
            viewModel.collapseAllScenes()
            viewModel.collapseAllChoices()

            adapter.submitList()
            initialStateAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
            updateTitleField()
            updateUndoRedoButtons()

            binding.tvSaveStatus.text = "Загружено из файла"
            binding.tvSaveStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))

            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Приключение загружено из файла: ${uri.lastPathSegment}")
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Приключение загружено", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Ошибка загрузки приключения: ${e.message}")
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Ошибка загрузки: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun extractTags(
        scene: com.myapp.adventure.data.Scene,
        tagDefs: Map<String, TagDefinition>
    ): MutableList<EditorTag> {
        return buildTagList(
            setFlags = scene.setFlags,
            removeFlags = scene.removeFlags,
            modifyStats = scene.modifyStats,
            tagDefs = tagDefs
        )
    }

    private fun extractChoiceTags(
        choice: com.myapp.adventure.data.Choice,
        tagDefs: Map<String, TagDefinition>
    ): MutableList<EditorTag> {
        return buildTagList(
            setFlags = choice.setFlags,
            removeFlags = choice.removeFlags,
            modifyStats = choice.modifyStats,
            tagDefs = tagDefs
        )
    }

    private fun buildTagList(
        setFlags: List<String>?,
        removeFlags: List<String>?,
        modifyStats: Map<String, Int>?,
        tagDefs: Map<String, TagDefinition>
    ): MutableList<EditorTag> {
        val tags = mutableListOf<EditorTag>()

        for (flag in setFlags.orEmpty()) {
            val def = tagDefs[flag]
            val category = def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL
            val value = if (category == TagCategory.ITEM) 1 else 0
            val isStat = category == TagCategory.ITEM
            tags.add(
                EditorTag(
                    name = flag,
                    value = value,
                    isStatModifier = isStat,
                    category = category,
                    displayName = def?.displayName ?: flag,
                    visible = def?.visible ?: false
                )
            )
        }

        for (flag in removeFlags.orEmpty()) {
            val def = tagDefs[flag]
            tags.add(
                EditorTag(
                    name = "!$flag",
                    value = 0,
                    isStatModifier = false,
                    category = def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL,
                    displayName = def?.displayName ?: flag,
                    visible = def?.visible ?: false
                )
            )
        }

        for ((stat, value) in modifyStats.orEmpty()) {
            val def = tagDefs[stat]
            tags.add(
                EditorTag(
                    name = stat,
                    value = value,
                    isStatModifier = true,
                    category = def?.category ?: TagCategory.JOURNAL,
                    displayName = def?.displayName ?: stat,
                    visible = def?.visible ?: false
                )
            )
        }

        return tags
    }

    // ---------- Сохранение в файл ----------

    private fun saveAdventure() {
        if (viewModel.scenes.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Добавьте хотя бы одну сцену", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }

        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)
        viewModel.freezeAllPendingIds()

        val adventure = viewModel.buildAdventure()
        val gson = com.google.gson.GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create()
        val json = gson.toJson(adventure)

        val prefs = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", 0)
        val folderUriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null)
        if (folderUriString == null) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Папка не выбрана", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        val folderUri = Uri.parse(folderUriString)

        try {
            val newAdventuresDirUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(
                folderUri,
                DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri) + "/NewAdventures"
            )
            val fileName = viewModel.transliterate(adventure.title.ifBlank { "adventure" }) + ".json"
            val existingFileUri = findFileInFolder(newAdventuresDirUri, fileName)

            var saved = false
            if (existingFileUri != null) {
                requireContext().contentResolver.openOutputStream(existingFileUri, "wt")?.use {
                    it.write(json.toByteArray())
                }
                Logger.log(requireContext(), "Приключение перезаписано: $fileName")
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Приключение обновлено: $fileName", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                saved = true
            } else {
                val newUri = DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                    requireContext().contentResolver,
                    newAdventuresDirUri,
                    "application/json",
                    fileName
                )
                if (newUri != null) {
                    requireContext().contentResolver.openOutputStream(newUri)?.use {
                        it.write(json.toByteArray())
                    }
                    Logger.log(requireContext(), "Приключение сохранено: $fileName")
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Приключение сохранено: $fileName", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    saved = true
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Не удалось создать файл", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }

            if (saved) {
                EditorDraftManager.clearDraft(requireContext())
                hasUnsavedChanges = false
                binding.tvSaveStatus.text = "Сохранено в файл"
                binding.tvSaveStatus.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
                updateUndoRedoButtons()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Ошибка сохранения: ${e.message}")
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Ошибка сохранения: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun findFileInFolder(folderUri: Uri, fileName: String): Uri? {
        val contentResolver = requireContext().contentResolver
        val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
            folderUri,
            DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(folderUri)
        )
        contentResolver.query(childrenUri, null, null, null, null)?.use {
            while (it.moveToNext()) {
                val displayName = it.getString(
                    it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
                )
                if (displayName == fileName) {
                    val docId = it.getString(
                        it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
                    )
                    return DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, docId)
                }
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    // ---------- Валидатор ----------

    private fun showValidationDialog() {
        val issues = StoryValidator.validate(viewModel.scenes, viewModel.buildInitialState())

        if (issues.isEmpty()) {
            AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                .setTitle("Здоровье истории")
                .setMessage("Проблем не найдено. История выглядит здоровой! ✅")
                .setPositiveButton("Закрыть", null)
                .show()
            return
        }

        val errorCount = issues.count { it.severity == IssueSeverity.ERROR }
        val warningCount = issues.count { it.severity == IssueSeverity.WARNING }

        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.dialog_validation_issues, null)
        val tvSummary = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_summary)
        val container = dialogView.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.container_issues)

        val summaryParts = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (errorCount > 0) summaryParts.add("Ошибок: $errorCount")
        if (warningCount > 0) summaryParts.add("Предупреждений: $warningCount")
        tvSummary.text = summaryParts.joinToString(" • ")

        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Здоровье истории")
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton("Закрыть", null)
            .create()

        val ordered = issues.filter { it.severity == IssueSeverity.ERROR } +
                issues.filter { it.severity == IssueSeverity.WARNING }

        for (issue in ordered) {
            val rowView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
                .inflate(R.layout.item_validation_issue, container, false)
            val icon = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_severity_icon)
            val title = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_title)
            val desc = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_description)

            icon.text = if (issue.severity == IssueSeverity.ERROR) "❌" else "⚠️"
            title.text = issue.title
            desc.text = issue.description

            rowView.setOnClickListener {
                dialog.dismiss()
                jumpToScene(issue.sceneUid)
            }
            container.addView(rowView)
        }

        dialog.show()
    }

    // ---------- Поиск ----------

    private fun showSearchDialog() {
        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.dialog_search, null)

        val etQuery = dialogView.findViewById<EditText>(R.id.et_search_query)
        val cbTitles = dialogView.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cb_search_titles)
        val cbTexts = dialogView.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cb_search_texts)
        val cbChoices = dialogView.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cb_search_choices)
        val cbTags = dialogView.findViewById<CheckBox>(R.id.cb_search_tags)
        val tvSummary = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_search_summary)
        val container = dialogView.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.container_results)

        cbTitles.isChecked = true
        cbTexts.isChecked = true
        cbChoices.isChecked = true
        cbTags.isChecked = true

        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Поиск по истории")
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton("Закрыть", null)
            .create()

        val searchHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
        var searchRunnable: Runnable? = null

        fun runSearch() {
            val query = etQuery.text.toString()
            if (query.trim().length < 2) {
                tvSummary.text = "Введите минимум 2 символа"
                container.removeAllViews()
                return
            }

            val results = SearchService.search(
                scenes = viewModel.scenes,
                query = query,
                searchInTitles = cbTitles.isChecked,
                searchInTexts = cbTexts.isChecked,
                searchInChoices = cbChoices.isChecked,
                searchInTags = cbTags.isChecked
            )

            container.removeAllViews()

            if (results.isEmpty()) {
                tvSummary.text = "Ничего не найдено"
                return
            }

            val scenesCount = results.map { it.sceneUid }.distinct().size
            val totalMatches = results.sumOf { it.totalMatchesInField }

            val summary = StringBuilder("Найдено ")
            summary.append(formatMatchesCount(totalMatches))
            if (scenesCount > 1) {
                summary.append(" ")
                summary.append(formatScenesPrepositional(scenesCount))
            }
            tvSummary.text = summary.toString()

            for (result in results) {
                val rowView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
                    .inflate(R.layout.item_search_result, container, false)
                val tvIcon = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_search_icon)
                val tvTitleDetail = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_search_title_detail)
                val tvContext = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_search_context)

                tvIcon.text = result.fieldType.icon

                val titleDetailText = buildString {
                    append(result.sceneTitle)
                    append("  ·  ")
                    append(result.detail)
                    if (result.totalMatchesInField > 1) {
                        append("  (ещё ")
                        append(result.totalMatchesInField - 1)
                        append(")")
                    }
                }
                val spannableTitle = SpannableString(titleDetailText)
                spannableTitle.setSpan(
                    StyleSpan(Typeface.BOLD),
                    0, result.sceneTitle.length,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
                spannableTitle.setSpan(
                    ForegroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#AAAAAA")),
                    result.sceneTitle.length, titleDetailText.length,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
                tvTitleDetail.text = spannableTitle

                val contextText = "«…${result.contextBefore}${result.match}${result.contextAfter}…»"
                val spannableCtx = SpannableString(contextText)
                val matchStart = 2 + result.contextBefore.length
                val matchEnd = matchStart + result.match.length
                spannableCtx.setSpan(
                    BackgroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#FFC107")),
                    matchStart, matchEnd,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
                spannableCtx.setSpan(
                    ForegroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#000000")),
                    matchStart, matchEnd,
                    Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE
                )
                tvContext.text = spannableCtx

                rowView.setOnClickListener {
                    dialog.dismiss()
                    searchHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
                    jumpToScene(result.sceneUid)
                }
                container.addView(rowView)
            }
        }

        val watcher = object : TextWatcher {
            override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) {
                searchRunnable?.let { searchHandler.removeCallbacks(it) }
                val r = Runnable { runSearch() }
                searchRunnable = r
                searchHandler.postDelayed(r, 300L)
            }
            override fun beforeTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, st: Int, c: Int, a: Int) {}
            override fun onTextChanged(s: CharSequence?, st: Int, b: Int, c: Int) {}
        }
        etQuery.addTextChangedListener(watcher)

        val filterListener = CompoundButton.OnCheckedChangeListener { _, _ -> runSearch() }
        cbTitles.setOnCheckedChangeListener(filterListener)
        cbTexts.setOnCheckedChangeListener(filterListener)
        cbChoices.setOnCheckedChangeListener(filterListener)
        cbTags.setOnCheckedChangeListener(filterListener)

        dialog.setOnDismissListener {
            searchHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
        }

        dialog.show()
        etQuery.requestFocus()
        tvSummary.text = "Введите минимум 2 символа"
    }

    private fun formatMatchesCount(n: Int): String = when {
        n % 100 in 11..14 -> "$n совпадений"
        n % 10 == 1 -> "$n совпадение"
        n % 10 in 2..4 -> "$n совпадения"
        else -> "$n совпадений"
    }

    private fun formatScenesPrepositional(n: Int): String = when {
        n % 100 in 11..14 -> "в $n сценах"
        n % 10 == 1 -> "в $n сцене"
        else -> "в $n сценах"
    }

    // ---------- Статистика ----------

    private fun showStatsDialog() {
        val stats = StoryStatsService.calculate(viewModel.scenes)

        val dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.dialog_story_stats, null)

        val tvScenes = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_scenes)
        val tvWords = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_words)
        val tvChoices = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_choices)
        val tvChapters = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_chapters)
        val tvReading = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_reading_time)
        val tvAvg = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_avg)
        val tvLongest = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_longest)
        val tvShortest = dialogView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_stat_shortest)
        val containerChapters = dialogView.findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.container_chapters)

        tvScenes.text = "📄  Сцен: ${formatInt(stats.totalScenes)} (${formatScenes(stats.totalScenes)})"
        tvWords.text = "📝  Слов: ${formatInt(stats.totalWords)}"
        tvChoices.text = "🔀  Выборов: ${formatInt(stats.totalChoices)}"
        tvChapters.text = "📚  Глав: ${formatInt(stats.totalChapters)}"

        tvReading.text = "⏱  Примерное время чтения: ${formatReadingTime(stats.estimatedReadingMinutes)}"

        if (stats.totalScenes > 0) {
            tvAvg.text = "Средняя длина сцены: ${formatInt(stats.avgWordsPerScene)} ${formatWords(stats.avgWordsPerScene)}"
            tvLongest.text = "Самая длинная: «${stats.longestSceneTitle}» — ${formatInt(stats.longestSceneWords)} ${formatWords(stats.longestSceneWords)}"
            tvShortest.text = "Самая короткая: «${stats.shortestSceneTitle}» — ${formatInt(stats.shortestSceneWords)} ${formatWords(stats.shortestSceneWords)}"
        } else {
            tvAvg.text = ""
            tvLongest.text = ""
            tvShortest.text = ""
        }

        containerChapters.removeAllViews()
        for (chapter in stats.chapters) {
            addChapterStatsRow(containerChapters, chapter)
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
            .setTitle("Статистика истории")
            .setView(dialogView)
            .setPositiveButton("Закрыть", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun addChapterStatsRow(
        container: LinearLayout,
        chapter: ChapterStats
    ) {
        val rowView = LayoutInflater.from(requireContext())
            .inflate(R.layout.item_chapter_stats, container, false)
        val tvTitle = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_chapter_title)
        val tvDetails = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_chapter_details)
        val tvSteps = rowView.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_chapter_steps)

        tvTitle.text = "Глава ${chapter.index}"

        tvDetails.text = "${formatInt(chapter.sceneCount)} ${formatScenes(chapter.sceneCount)}" +
                " · ${formatInt(chapter.wordCount)} ${formatWords(chapter.wordCount)}" +
                " · ${formatInt(chapter.choiceCount)} ${formatChoices(chapter.choiceCount)}"

        if (chapter.isLast) {
            tvSteps.text = "🏁 Финальная глава"
            tvSteps.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#4CAF50"))
        } else if (chapter.requiredSteps > 0) {
            tvSteps.text = "🚶 До следующей главы: ${formatInt(chapter.requiredSteps)} ${formatSteps(chapter.requiredSteps)}"
            tvSteps.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FFC107"))
        } else {
            tvSteps.text = "⚠️ До следующей главы: 0 шагов (откроется сразу)"
            tvSteps.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FF9800"))
        }

        container.addView(rowView)
    }

    // ---------- Форматирование чисел и склонений ----------

    private fun formatInt(n: Int): String =
        String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%,d", n).replace(',', ' ')

    private fun formatScenes(n: Int): String = when {
        n % 100 in 11..14 -> "сцен"
        n % 10 == 1 -> "сцена"
        n % 10 in 2..4 -> "сцены"
        else -> "сцен"
    }

    private fun formatWords(n: Int): String = when {
        n % 100 in 11..14 -> "слов"
        n % 10 == 1 -> "слово"
        n % 10 in 2..4 -> "слова"
        else -> "слов"
    }

    private fun formatChoices(n: Int): String = when {
        n % 100 in 11..14 -> "выборов"
        n % 10 == 1 -> "выбор"
        n % 10 in 2..4 -> "выбора"
        else -> "выборов"
    }

    private fun formatSteps(n: Int): String = when {
        n % 100 in 11..14 -> "шагов"
        n % 10 == 1 -> "шаг"
        n % 10 in 2..4 -> "шага"
        else -> "шагов"
    }

    private fun formatReadingTime(minutes: Int): String {
        if (minutes < 1) return "меньше минуты"
        return "${formatInt(minutes)} ${when {
            minutes % 100 in 11..14 -> "минут"
            minutes % 10 == 1 -> "минута"
            minutes % 10 in 2..4 -> "минуты"
            else -> "минут"
        }}"
    }

    // ---------- Прыжок к сцене ----------

    private fun jumpToScene(uid: String) {
        if (_binding == null) return
        val pos = viewModel.scenes.indexOfFirst { it.uid == uid }
        if (pos < 0) return

        viewModel.expandScene(uid)
        adapter.submitList()

        binding.rvScenes.post {
            if (_binding == null) return@post
            (binding.rvScenes.layoutManager as? LinearLayoutManager)
                ?.scrollToPositionWithOffset(pos + 1, 50)  // +1 — InitialStateAdapter

            adapter.setHighlighted(uid)
            debounceHandler.postDelayed({
                if (_binding != null) adapter.setHighlighted(null)
            }, 2500L)
        }
    }

    // ---------- Предпросмотр сцены ----------

    private fun openPreview(sceneUid: String) {
        val scene = viewModel.scenes.find { it.uid == sceneUid } ?: return

        if (scene.title.isBlank()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                requireContext(),
                "Сначала задайте название сцены",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show()
            return
        }

        viewModel.freezeAllPendingIds()

        if (scene.id.isBlank()) {
            Toast.makeText(
                requireContext(),
                "Не удалось сгенерировать ID сцены",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show()
            return
        }

        val adventure = viewModel.buildAdventure()
        val gson = Gson()

        val chapterIndex = adventure.chapters?.indexOfFirst { chapter ->
            chapter.scenes?.any { it.id == scene.id } == true
        } ?: -1

        if (chapterIndex < 0) {
            Toast.makeText(
                requireContext(),
                "Сцена не найдена в собранной истории",
                Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
            ).show()
            return
        }

        val fragment = AdventureReaderFragment().apply {
            arguments = Bundle().apply {
                putString("adventure_json", gson.toJson(adventure))
                putString("preview_scene_id", scene.id)
                putInt("preview_chapter_index", chapterIndex)
                putBoolean("preview_mode", true)
            }
        }

        parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
            .replace(R.id.fragment_container, fragment)
            .addToBackStack(null)
            .commit()

        Logger.log(requireContext(), "Предпросмотр сцены '${scene.id}' (глава ${chapterIndex + 1})")
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        debounceHandler.removeCallbacks(saveRunnable)

        if (_binding != null && hasUnsavedChanges && viewModel.scenes.isNotEmpty()) {
            EditorDraftManager.saveDraft(
                requireContext(),
                viewModel.title,
                viewModel.author,
                viewModel.description,
                viewModel.initialStateTags,
                viewModel.scenes
            )
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Черновик сохранён при выходе из редактора")
        }
        _binding = null
    }

    companion object {
        private const val DEBOUNCE_MS = 400L
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.ui.editor

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import com.myapp.adventure.data.Adventure
import com.myapp.adventure.data.Chapter
import com.myapp.adventure.data.Choice
import com.myapp.adventure.data.DeathScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorChoice
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorSnapshot
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorTag
import com.myapp.adventure.data.PlayerState
import com.myapp.adventure.data.RebuildResult
import com.myapp.adventure.data.Scene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.TagCategory
import com.myapp.adventure.data.TagDefinition
import com.myapp.adventure.data.deepCopy
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger

class AdventureEditorViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {

    val scenes = mutableListOf<EditorScene>()
    var title: String = ""
    var author: String = ""
    var description: String = ""

    val initialStateTags: MutableList<EditorTag> = mutableListOf()
    var initialStateExpanded: Boolean = false

    private val expandedScenes = mutableSetOf<String>()
    private val expandedChoices = mutableSetOf<String>()
    private val expandedMapChapters = mutableSetOf<Int>()

    var pendingJumpToSceneUid: String? = null

    private val history = ArrayDeque<EditorSnapshot>()
    private val redoStack = ArrayDeque<EditorSnapshot>()

    private val context get() = getApplication<Application>().applicationContext

    // ---------- Аккордеон сцен ----------

    fun isSceneExpanded(uid: String): Boolean = uid in expandedScenes
    fun expandScene(uid: String) { expandedScenes.add(uid) }

    fun toggleSceneExpanded(uid: String): Boolean {
        return if (uid in expandedScenes) {
            expandedScenes.remove(uid)
            false
        } else {
            expandedScenes.add(uid)
            true
        }
    }

    fun collapseAllScenes() { expandedScenes.clear() }

    private fun pruneExpandedScenes() {
        val currentUids = scenes.map { it.uid }.toSet()
        expandedScenes.retainAll(currentUids)
        expandedSceneSettings.retainAll(currentUids)
    }

    // ---------- Аккордеон: настройки сцены (2d-ii) ----------
    //
    // "Настройки сцены" — collapsed sub-block of a scene that holds
    // the authoring checkboxes (chapter end / step gate / ending /
    // death scene + their sub-options). Collapsed by default: a
    // scene with all four flags would otherwise be 6 checkboxes tall
    // and push choices off-screen. State is per-scene (per uid) and
    // survives scrolling; it is pruned on scene deletion alongside
    // `expandedScenes`.
    private val expandedSceneSettings = mutableSetOf<String>()

    fun isSceneSettingsExpanded(uid: String): Boolean = uid in expandedSceneSettings

    fun toggleSceneSettings(uid: String): Boolean {
        return if (uid in expandedSceneSettings) {
            expandedSceneSettings.remove(uid)
            false
        } else {
            expandedSceneSettings.add(uid)
            true
        }
    }

    // ---------- Аккордеон выборов ----------

    fun isChoiceExpanded(uid: String): Boolean = uid in expandedChoices

    fun toggleChoiceExpanded(uid: String): Boolean {
        return if (uid in expandedChoices) {
            expandedChoices.remove(uid)
            false
        } else {
            expandedChoices.add(uid)
            true
        }
    }

    fun collapseAllChoices() { expandedChoices.clear() }

    private fun pruneExpandedChoices() {
        val currentUids = scenes.flatMap { it.choices.map { c -> c.uid } }.toSet()
        expandedChoices.retainAll(currentUids)
    }

    // ---------- Карта: аккордеон глав ----------

    fun isMapChapterExpanded(index: Int): Boolean = index in expandedMapChapters

    fun toggleMapChapterExpanded(index: Int) {
        if (index in expandedMapChapters) expandedMapChapters.remove(index)
        else expandedMapChapters.add(index)
    }

    fun ensureFirstMapChapterExpanded(totalChapters: Int) {
        if (expandedMapChapters.isEmpty() && totalChapters > 0) {
            expandedMapChapters.add(0)
        }
    }

    fun collapseAllMapChapters() { expandedMapChapters.clear() }

    // ---------- История Undo/Redo ----------

    fun isHistoryInitialized(): Boolean = history.isNotEmpty()

    fun initHistory() {
        history.clear()
        redoStack.clear()
        history.addLast(takeSnapshot())
    }

    fun takeSnapshot(): EditorSnapshot = EditorSnapshot(
        title = title,
        author = author,
        description = description,
        initialStateTags = initialStateTags.map { it.copy() },
        scenes = scenes.map { it.deepCopy() }
    )

    fun restoreSnapshot(snapshot: EditorSnapshot) {
        title = snapshot.title
        author = snapshot.author
        description = snapshot.description
        initialStateTags.clear()
        initialStateTags.addAll(snapshot.initialStateTags.map { it.copy() })
        scenes.clear()
        scenes.addAll(snapshot.scenes.map { it.deepCopy() })
        pruneExpandedScenes()
        pruneExpandedChoices()
    }

    fun commitSnapshot() {
        val current = takeSnapshot()
        if (current == history.lastOrNull()) return
        history.addLast(current)
        while (history.size > MAX_HISTORY) history.removeFirst()
        redoStack.clear()
    }

    fun undo(): Boolean {
        if (history.size < 2) return false
        val current = history.removeLast()
        redoStack.addLast(current)
        restoreSnapshot(history.last())
        return true
    }

    fun redo(): Boolean {
        if (redoStack.isEmpty()) return false
        val next = redoStack.removeLast()
        history.addLast(next)
        while (history.size > MAX_HISTORY) history.removeFirst()
        restoreSnapshot(next)
        return true
    }

    fun canUndo(): Boolean = history.size >= 2
    fun canRedo(): Boolean = redoStack.isNotEmpty()

    // ---------- Транслитерация и ID ----------

    fun transliterate(text: String): String {
        val translitMap = mapOf(
            'а' to "a", 'б' to "b", 'в' to "v", 'г' to "g", 'д' to "d",
            'е' to "e", 'ё' to "yo", 'ж' to "zh", 'з' to "z", 'и' to "i",
            'й' to "y", 'к' to "k", 'л' to "l", 'м' to "m", 'н' to "n",
            'о' to "o", 'п' to "p", 'р' to "r", 'с' to "s", 'т' to "t",
            'у' to "u", 'ф' to "f", 'х' to "h", 'ц' to "ts", 'ч' to "ch",
            'ш' to "sh", 'щ' to "sch", 'ъ' to "", 'ы' to "y", 'ь' to "",
            'э' to "e", 'ю' to "yu", 'я' to "ya",
            'А' to "A", 'Б' to "B", 'В' to "V", 'Г' to "G", 'Д' to "D",
            'Е' to "E", 'Ё' to "Yo", 'Ж' to "Zh", 'З' to "Z", 'И' to "I",
            'Й' to "Y", 'К' to "K", 'Л' to "L", 'М' to "M", 'Н' to "N",
            'О' to "O", 'П' to "P", 'Р' to "R", 'С' to "S", 'Т' to "T",
            'У' to "U", 'Ф' to "F", 'Х' to "H", 'Ц' to "Ts", 'Ч' to "Ch",
            'Ш' to "Sh", 'Щ' to "Sch", 'Ъ' to "", 'Ы' to "Y", 'Ь' to "",
            'Э' to "E", 'Ю' to "Yu", 'Я' to "Ya"
        )
        return text.map { translitMap[it] ?: it.toString() }.joinToString("")
            .replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9_\\- ]"), "")
            .trim().replace(" ", "_").ifEmpty { "adventure" }
    }

    fun generateSceneId(title: String, excludeIds: Set<String> = emptySet()): String {
        val base = transliterate(title).lowercase()
            .replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9_]"), "_")
            .trimEnd('_')
            .ifEmpty { "scene" }

        var id = base
        var counter = 2
        while (id in excludeIds || scenes.any { it.id == id }) {
            id = "${base}_$counter"
            counter++
        }
        return id
    }

    // ---------- ID-заморозка и пересборка ----------

    fun freezeSceneId(sceneUid: String): Boolean {
        val scene = scenes.find { it.uid == sceneUid } ?: return false
        if (!scene.idIsAuto) return false
        if (scene.title.isBlank()) return false

        val oldId = scene.id
        scene.id = ""
        val newId = generateSceneId(scene.title)
        scene.id = newId
        scene.idIsAuto = false

        if (newId == oldId) return false
        val updatedRefs = updateReferences(oldId, newId)
        Logger.log(context, "ID сцены '${scene.title}' заморожен: '$oldId' → '$newId', обновлено ссылок: $updatedRefs")
        return true
    }

    fun rebuildSceneId(sceneUid: String): RebuildResult? {
        val scene = scenes.find { it.uid == sceneUid } ?: return null
        if (scene.title.isBlank()) return null

        val oldId = scene.id
        scene.id = ""
        val newId = generateSceneId(scene.title)
        scene.id = newId
        scene.idIsAuto = false

        val updatedRefs = if (newId != oldId) updateReferences(oldId, newId) else 0
        Logger.log(context, "ID сцены пересобран: '$oldId' → '$newId', обновлено ссылок: $updatedRefs")
        return RebuildResult(oldId, newId, updatedRefs)
    }

    fun previewRebuiltId(sceneUid: String): String? {
        val scene = scenes.find { it.uid == sceneUid } ?: return null
        if (scene.title.isBlank()) return null
        val oldId = scene.id
        scene.id = ""
        val preview = generateSceneId(scene.title)
        scene.id = oldId
        return preview
    }

    fun freezeAllPendingIds() {
        scenes.toList().forEach { scene ->
            if (scene.idIsAuto) {
                if (scene.title.isNotBlank()) {
                    freezeSceneId(scene.uid)
                } else {
                    scene.idIsAuto = false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun updateReferences(oldId: String, newId: String): Int {
        if (oldId.isEmpty() || oldId == newId) return 0
        var count = 0
        scenes.forEach { other ->
            other.choices.forEach { c ->
                if (c.nextSceneId == oldId) {
                    c.nextSceneId = newId
                    count++
                }
            }
        }
        return count
    }

    // ---------- Изменения структуры ----------

    fun addScene() {
        val newScene = EditorScene()
        scenes.add(newScene)
        expandedScenes.add(newScene.uid)
        Logger.log(context, "Добавлена сцена, индекс: ${scenes.size - 1}")
    }

    fun addSceneWithTitle(title: String): EditorScene {
        val trimmed = title.trim()
        val newScene = EditorScene(
            title = trimmed,
            idIsAuto = trimmed.isEmpty()
        )
        if (trimmed.isNotEmpty()) {
            newScene.id = generateSceneId(trimmed)
        }
        scenes.add(newScene)
        expandedScenes.add(newScene.uid)
        Logger.log(context, "Добавлена сцена '${trimmed.ifEmpty { "(без названия)" }}', индекс: ${scenes.size - 1}")
        return newScene
    }

    fun removeScene(index: Int) {
        if (index in scenes.indices) {
            val removed = scenes.removeAt(index)
            expandedScenes.remove(removed.uid)
            Logger.log(context, "Удалена сцена: ${removed.title.ifEmpty { "(без названия)" }}, индекс: $index")
        }
    }

    fun setDeathScene(sceneUid: String, enabled: Boolean) {
        if (enabled) {
            scenes.forEach { if (it.uid != sceneUid) it.isDeathScene = false }
        }
        scenes.find { it.uid == sceneUid }?.isDeathScene = enabled
    }

    fun addChoice(sceneIndex: Int) {
        val scene = scenes.getOrNull(sceneIndex) ?: return
        val choice = EditorChoice()
        scene.choices.add(choice)
        expandedChoices.add(choice.uid)
        Logger.log(context, "Добавлен выбор в сцену '${scene.title}' (индекс $sceneIndex)")
    }

    fun removeChoice(sceneIndex: Int, choiceIndex: Int) {
        val scene = scenes.getOrNull(sceneIndex) ?: return
        if (choiceIndex in scene.choices.indices) {
            scene.choices.removeAt(choiceIndex)
            Logger.log(context, "Удалён выбор из сцены '${scene.title}' (индекс сцены $sceneIndex, выбор $choiceIndex)")
        }
    }

    fun addTag(sceneIndex: Int) {
        val scene = scenes.getOrNull(sceneIndex) ?: return
        scene.tags.add(EditorTag())
        Logger.log(context, "Добавлена метка в сцену '${scene.title}' (индекс $sceneIndex)")
    }

    fun removeTag(sceneIndex: Int, tagIndex: Int) {
        val scene = scenes.getOrNull(sceneIndex) ?: return
        if (tagIndex in scene.tags.indices) {
            val removedTag = scene.tags.removeAt(tagIndex)
            Logger.log(context, "Удалена метка '${removedTag.name}' из сцены '${scene.title}' (индекс сцены $sceneIndex)")
        }
    }

    fun getSceneOptions(): List<Pair<String, String>> {
        return scenes.map { scene ->
            scene.title.ifEmpty { "(без названия)" } to scene.id
        }
    }

    // ---------- Начальное состояние ----------

    fun addInitialStateTag() {
        initialStateTags.add(EditorTag(category = TagCategory.JOURNAL))
    }

    fun removeInitialStateTag(index: Int) {
        if (index in initialStateTags.indices) {
            initialStateTags.removeAt(index)
        }
    }

    fun buildInitialState(): PlayerState? {
        if (initialStateTags.isEmpty()) return null

        val flags = mutableListOf<String>()
        val stats = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()

        for (tag in initialStateTags) {
            if (tag.name.isBlank() || tag.name.startsWith("!")) continue
            val effectiveCategory = if (tag.name == "health") TagCategory.HEALTH else tag.category
            when (effectiveCategory) {
                TagCategory.HEALTH, TagCategory.ITEM -> {
                    stats[tag.name] = tag.value
                }
                TagCategory.JOURNAL -> {
                    if (tag.isStatModifier || tag.value != 0) {
                        stats[tag.name] = tag.value
                    } else {
                        if (!flags.contains(tag.name)) flags.add(tag.name)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (flags.isEmpty() && stats.isEmpty()) return null
        return PlayerState(
            flags = flags.ifEmpty { null },
            stats = stats.ifEmpty { null }
        )
    }

    // ---------- Сборка Adventure ----------

    private fun serializeTags(tags: List<EditorTag>): Triple<List<String>?, List<String>?, Map<String, Int>?> {
        val setFlagsSet = linkedSetOf<String>()
        val removeFlagsSet = linkedSetOf<String>()
        val modifyStatsMap = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()

        for (tag in tags) {
            val rawName = tag.name
            if (rawName.isBlank()) continue

            if (rawName.startsWith("!")) {
                val cleanName = rawName.removePrefix("!")
                if (tag.category == TagCategory.JOURNAL) {
                    removeFlagsSet.add(cleanName)
                }
                continue
            }

            val effectiveCategory = if (rawName == "health") TagCategory.HEALTH else tag.category
            when (effectiveCategory) {
                TagCategory.HEALTH, TagCategory.ITEM -> {
                    if (tag.value != 0) {
                        modifyStatsMap[rawName] = (modifyStatsMap[rawName] ?: 0) + tag.value
                    }
                }
                TagCategory.JOURNAL -> {
                    if (tag.isStatModifier || tag.value != 0) {
                        modifyStatsMap[rawName] = (modifyStatsMap[rawName] ?: 0) + tag.value
                    } else {
                        setFlagsSet.add(rawName)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return Triple(
            setFlagsSet.toList().ifEmpty { null },
            removeFlagsSet.toList().ifEmpty { null },
            modifyStatsMap.ifEmpty { null }
        )
    }

    fun buildAdventure(): Adventure {
        Logger.log(context, "Сборка приключения '${title}' в JSON-модель")
        val chapters = mutableListOf<Chapter>()
        val sceneList = mutableListOf<Scene>()
        var chapterIndex = 1

        // Ищем сцену смерти и исключаем её из обычного обхода
        val deathSceneEditor = scenes.firstOrNull { it.isDeathScene }

        for (scene in scenes) {
            if (scene.isDeathScene) continue

            val (sceneSetFlags, sceneRemoveFlags, sceneModifyStats) = serializeTags(scene.tags)

            val sceneObj = Scene(
                id = scene.id.ifEmpty { "scene_${scenes.indexOf(scene)}" },
                text = scene.text,
                setFlags = sceneSetFlags,
                removeFlags = sceneRemoveFlags,
                modifyStats = sceneModifyStats,
                choices = scene.choices.map { choice ->
                    val (choiceSetFlags, choiceRemoveFlags, choiceModifyStats) =
                        serializeTags(choice.tags)
                    Choice(
                        text = choice.text,
                        nextScene = choice.nextSceneId,
                        condition = choice.conditionTag.ifEmpty { null },
                        setFlags = choiceSetFlags,
                        removeFlags = choiceRemoveFlags,
                        modifyStats = choiceModifyStats
                    )
                }.ifEmpty { null },
                // Ф1.7.5: emit `"is_ending": true` only when the flag is
                // set. Gson with a non-null `false` would write
                // `"is_ending": false` on every scene, cluttering the
                // JSON and making the field appear on files where the
                // author never touched it. `null` → Gson omits the
                // field → on load, `JsonToIr` defaults it to `false`
                // (identity migration). This matches the style of
                // `setFlags` / `choices` above (empty → omit).
                isEnding = if (scene.isEnding) true else null,
                // b2: per-scene gate. Omit `"gate"` when 0 (no gate);
                // omit `"gate_repeatable"` when `false` (default).
                // Same "empty → omit" style as `setFlags` above.
                gate = if (scene.gateRequiredSteps > 0) scene.gateRequiredSteps else null,
                gateRepeatable =
                    if (scene.gateRequiredSteps > 0 && scene.gateRepeatable) true else null
            )
            sceneList.add(sceneObj)

            if (scene.isChapterEnd || scene == scenes.lastOrNull { !it.isDeathScene }) {
                val chapterId = "chapter_$chapterIndex"
                chapters.add(
                    Chapter(
                        id = chapterId,
                        title = "Глава $chapterIndex",
                        // b2: chapter-level `required_steps` is legacy
                        // (v1). The editor writes per-scene `gate` now;
                        // `requiredSteps` stays `null` so Gson omits the
                        // field entirely (`:app/data/Chapter.requiredSteps`
                        // is `Int?` after b2). `JsonToIr.parse` handles
                        // both v1 files (migrates `required_steps`) and
                        // v5 files (reads per-scene `gate`).
                        requiredSteps = null,
                        scenes = sceneList.toList()
                    )
                )
                Logger.log(context, "Сформирована глава $chapterId (сцен: ${sceneList.size})")
                sceneList.clear()
                chapterIndex++
            }
        }

        // Собираем реестр меток из tags сцен, tags выборов и initial_state
        val tagRegistry = LinkedHashMap<String, TagDefinition>()

        fun registerTag(tag: EditorTag) {
            val cleanName = tag.name.removePrefix("!")
            if (cleanName.isBlank()) return

            // Хардкод: health всегда HEALTH
            val effectiveCategory = if (cleanName == "health") TagCategory.HEALTH else tag.category
            val effectiveDisplay = if (cleanName == "health" && tag.displayName.isBlank()) {
                "Здоровье"
            } else {
                tag.displayName.ifBlank { cleanName }
            }

            tagRegistry[cleanName] = TagDefinition(
                name = cleanName,
                displayName = effectiveDisplay,
                category = effectiveCategory,
                visible = tag.visible
            )
        }

        for (tag in initialStateTags) registerTag(tag)
        for (scene in scenes) {
            for (tag in scene.tags) registerTag(tag)
            for (choice in scene.choices) {
                for (tag in choice.tags) registerTag(tag)
            }
        }

        // Метки из условий, которые нигде не объявлены
        for (scene in scenes) {
            for (choice in scene.choices) {
                val cond = choice.conditionTag.trim()
                if (cond.isEmpty()) continue
                val flagName = when {
                    cond.startsWith("!has_") -> cond.removePrefix("!has_").trim()
                    cond.startsWith("has_") -> cond.removePrefix("has_").trim()
                    else -> null
                }
                if (flagName != null && flagName !in tagRegistry) {
                    tagRegistry[flagName] = TagDefinition(
                        name = flagName,
                        displayName = flagName,
                        category = TagCategory.JOURNAL,
                        visible = false
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // Собираем DeathScene из помеченной сцены
        val deathScene = deathSceneEditor?.let {
            DeathScene(
                id = it.id.ifEmpty { "death_scene" },
                text = it.text,
                allowStepBack = it.deathAllowStepBack,
                allowChapterRestart = it.deathAllowChapterRestart,
                allowAdventureRestart = it.deathAllowAdventureRestart
            )
        }

        return Adventure(
            title = title,
            author = author,
            description = description,
            initialState = buildInitialState(),
            tags = tagRegistry.values.toList(),
            deathScene = deathScene,
            chapters = chapters
        )
    }

    companion object {
        private const val MAX_HISTORY = 20
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.ui.editor

import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.graphics.Color
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene

class AdventureMapAdapter(
    private val items: List<MapItem>,
    private val onChapterClick: (Int) -> Unit,
    private val onSceneClick: (String) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder>() {

    companion object {
        private const val TYPE_CHAPTER_HEADER = 0
        private const val TYPE_SCENE_ROW = 1
        private const val TYPE_STEPS_GATE = 2
    }

    inner class ChapterViewHolder(val root: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(root) {
        val chevron: TextView = root.findViewById(R.id.tv_chapter_chevron)
        val title: TextView = root.findViewById(R.id.tv_chapter_title)
        val stats: TextView = root.findViewById(R.id.tv_chapter_stats)
    }

    inner class SceneViewHolder(val root: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(root) {
        val title: TextView = root.findViewById(R.id.tv_scene_title)
        val badges: TextView = root.findViewById(R.id.tv_scene_badges)
        val transitionsContainer: LinearLayout = root.findViewById(R.id.container_transitions)
    }

    inner class StepsGateViewHolder(val root: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(root) {
        val text: TextView = root.findViewById(R.id.tv_gate_text)
    }

    override fun getItemViewType(position: Int): Int = when (items[position]) {
        is MapItem.ChapterHeader -> TYPE_CHAPTER_HEADER
        is MapItem.SceneRow -> TYPE_SCENE_ROW
        is MapItem.StepsGate -> TYPE_STEPS_GATE
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        val inflater = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
        return when (viewType) {
            TYPE_CHAPTER_HEADER -> ChapterViewHolder(
                inflater.inflate(R.layout.item_map_chapter_header, parent, false)
            )
            TYPE_STEPS_GATE -> StepsGateViewHolder(
                inflater.inflate(R.layout.item_map_steps_gate, parent, false)
            )
            else -> SceneViewHolder(
                inflater.inflate(R.layout.item_map_scene_row, parent, false)
            )
        }
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        when (val item = items[position]) {
            is MapItem.ChapterHeader -> {
                holder as ChapterViewHolder
                holder.chevron.text = if (item.expanded) "▼" else "▶"
                holder.title.text = item.title
                val stats = StringBuilder("${item.sceneCount} ${formatScenes(item.sceneCount)}")
                if (item.wordCount > 0) {
                    stats.append(" · ${formatInt(item.wordCount)} сл.")
                }
                holder.stats.text = stats.toString()
                holder.root.setOnClickListener { onChapterClick(item.index) }
            }

            is MapItem.SceneRow -> {
                holder as SceneViewHolder
                val scene = item.scene
                holder.title.text = scene.title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" }

                // Бейджи: 🏁 если конец главы, 💬 если много выборов
                val badges = mutableListOf<String>()
                if (scene.isChapterEnd) badges.add("🏁")
                if (scene.choices.isNotEmpty()) badges.add("💬 ${scene.choices.size}")
                holder.badges.text = badges.joinToString(" ")

                // Переходы
                holder.transitionsContainer.removeAllViews()
                val inflater = LayoutInflater.from(holder.root.context)

                if (item.transitions.isEmpty()) {
                    val tv = TextView(holder.root.context).apply {
                        text = "(нет переходов)"
                        setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#9E9E9E"))
                        textSize = 11f
                    }
                    holder.transitionsContainer.addView(tv)
                } else {
                    for (tr in item.transitions) {
                        val chip = inflater.inflate(
                            R.layout.item_map_transition_chip,
                            holder.transitionsContainer, false
                        ) as TextView

                        val labelPrefix = if (tr.missing) "⚠️ " else "→ "
                        chip.text = "$labelPrefix${tr.targetTitle}"

                        val color = when {
                            tr.missing -> "#F44336"    // красный
                            tr.condition != null -> "#FF9800"  // оранжевый
                            else -> "#4CAF50"          // зелёный
                        }
                        chip.setTextColor(Color.parseColor(color))

                        chip.setOnClickListener {
                            if (!tr.missing && tr.targetSceneUid != null) {
                                onSceneClick(tr.targetSceneUid)
                            }
                        }
                        holder.transitionsContainer.addView(chip)
                    }
                }

                holder.root.setOnClickListener { onSceneClick(scene.uid) }
            }

            is MapItem.StepsGate -> {
                holder as StepsGateViewHolder
                val minutes = ((item.steps + 99) / 100).coerceAtLeast(1)
                val timeText = when {
                    item.steps == 0 -> "откроется сразу"
                    minutes < 60 -> "≈ $minutes мин"
                    else -> {
                        val hours = minutes / 60
                        val mins = minutes % 60
                        if (mins == 0) "≈ $hours ч" else "≈ $hours ч $mins мин"
                    }
                }
                val formatted = String.format(java.util.Locale.getDefault(), "%,d", item.steps).replace(',', ' ')
                holder.text.text = "🚶 ${formatted} шагов ($timeText)"
                holder.text.setTextColor(
                    if (item.steps == 0) Color.parseColor("#FF9800")
                    else Color.parseColor("#FFC107")
                )
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = items.size

    private fun formatInt(n: Int): String =
        String.format(java.util.Locale.getDefault(), "%,d", n).replace(',', ' ')

    private fun formatScenes(n: Int): String = when {
        n % 100 in 11..14 -> "сцен"
        n % 10 == 1 -> "сцена"
        n % 10 in 2..4 -> "сцены"
        else -> "сцен"
    }
}

// ---------- Модель элементов карты ----------

sealed class MapItem {
    data class ChapterHeader(
        val index: Int,
        val title: String,
        val sceneCount: Int,
        val wordCount: Int,
        val expanded: Boolean
    ) : MapItem()

    data class SceneRow(
        val scene: EditorScene,
        val transitions: List<TransitionInfo>
    ) : MapItem()

    data class StepsGate(val steps: Int) : MapItem()
}

data class TransitionInfo(
    val targetSceneUid: String?,    // null, если сцена не найдена
    val targetTitle: String,
    val condition: String?,
    val missing: Boolean
)
