package com.myapp.adventure.ui.setup

import android.Manifest
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import com.myapp.adventure.databinding.FragmentSetupBinding
import com.myapp.adventure.service.StepCounterConstants
import com.myapp.adventure.service.StepCounterService
import com.myapp.adventure.ui.list.AdventureListFragment
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.ProgressManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class SetupFragment : Fragment() {

    private var _binding: FragmentSetupBinding? = null
    private val binding get() = _binding!!

    private var permissionsChecked = false

    private val selectFolderLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocumentTree()
    ) { uri: Uri? ->
        if (uri != null) {
            try {
                val takeFlags = Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or
                        Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION
                requireContext().contentResolver.takePersistableUriPermission(uri, takeFlags)

                requireContext().getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", 0)
                    .edit()
                    .putString("adventure_folder_uri", uri.toString())
                    .apply()

                Logger.init(requireContext(), uri.toString())
                Logger.log(requireContext(), "Папка выбрана: $uri")

                createSubFolders(uri)

                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Папка выбрана!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

                // Запускаем постоянный шагомер, если ещё не работает
                startStepCounterService()

                parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                    .replace(R.id.fragment_container, AdventureListFragment())
                    .commit()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Logger.log(requireContext(), "Ошибка при выборе папки: ${e.message}")
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Ошибка: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Нужно выбрать папку для продолжения", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private val requestNotificationPermissionLauncher =
        registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()) { granted ->
            if (!granted) {
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Уведомления отключены. Шагомер не сможет работать в фоне.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
            requestActivityRecognition()
        }

    private val requestActivityRecognitionLauncher =
        registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission()) { granted ->
            if (!granted) {
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Разрешение на физическую активность не дано. Шаги не будут считаться.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
            permissionsChecked = true
            // После получения разрешений можно запускать шагомер
            startStepCounterService()
            updateUI()
        }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?
    ): View {
        _binding = FragmentSetupBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false)
        return binding.root
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)

        val prefs = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", 0)
        val savedUri = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null)

        // Если папка уже выбрана и валидна – сразу в список и запускаем шагомер
        if (savedUri != null && isFolderValid(Uri.parse(savedUri))) {
            Logger.init(requireContext(), savedUri)
            startStepCounterService()
            viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
                ProgressManager.warmUp(requireContext().applicationContext)
            }
            parentFragmentManager.beginTransaction()
                .replace(R.id.fragment_container, AdventureListFragment())
                .commit()
            return
        } else if (savedUri != null) {
            prefs.edit().remove("adventure_folder_uri").apply()
        }

        binding.btnSelectFolder.setOnClickListener {
            if (permissionsChecked) {
                selectFolderLauncher.launch(null)
            } else {
                checkAndRequestPermissions()
            }
        }

        // Запрашиваем разрешения сразу, если они не были запрошены
        if (!permissionsChecked) {
            checkAndRequestPermissions()
        }
        // Start periodic polling (no-op if HC is disabled — sensor writes directly)
        com.myapp.adventure.step.StepSourceManager.start(requireContext())
    }

    private fun isFolderValid(folderUri: Uri): Boolean {
        return try {
            val contentResolver = requireContext().contentResolver
            val docId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri)
            val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(folderUri, docId)
            val cursor = contentResolver.query(childrenUri, null, null, null, null)
            cursor?.close()
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    private fun checkAndRequestPermissions() {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
                if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(), Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
                    != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    if (shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)) {
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Разрешение на уведомления нужно, чтобы шагомер работал в фоне.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    }
                    requestNotificationPermissionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
                    return
                }
            }
            requestActivityRecognition()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Ошибка при запросе разрешений: ${e.message}")
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Ошибка: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun requestActivityRecognition() {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(), Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION)
                    != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    if (shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION)) {
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Доступ к физической активности нужен для подсчёта шагов.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    }
                    requestActivityRecognitionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION)
                    return
                }
            }
            permissionsChecked = true
            startStepCounterService()
            updateUI()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Ошибка при запросе активности: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    private fun updateUI() {
        if (_binding != null) {
            binding.btnSelectFolder.isEnabled = true
        }
    }

    private fun startStepCounterService() {
        if (!StepCounterService.isRunning) {
            val intent = Intent(requireContext(), StepCounterService::class.java).apply {
                action = StepCounterConstants.ACTION_START
            }
            requireContext().startForegroundService(intent)
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Сервис шагомера запущен из SetupFragment")
        }
    }

    // ... методы createSubFolders, copyTestAdventure и т.д. – без изменений

    private fun createSubFolders(parentUri: Uri) {
        val contentResolver = requireContext().contentResolver
        val parentDocId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(parentUri)

        try {
            DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                contentResolver,
                DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(parentUri, parentDocId),
                DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR,
                "Adventures"
            )
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Папка Adventures создана")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Папка Adventures уже существует или ошибка: ${e.message}")
        }

        try {
            DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                contentResolver,
                DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(parentUri, parentDocId),
                DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR,
                "NewAdventures"
            )
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Папка NewAdventures создана")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Папка NewAdventures уже существует или ошибка: ${e.message}")
        }

        copyTestAdventureIfNeeded(parentUri)
    }

    private fun copyTestAdventureIfNeeded(parentUri: Uri) {
        copyTestAdventure(parentUri, "test_adventure.json", R.raw.test_adventure)
    }

    private fun copyTestAdventure(parentUri: Uri, fileName: String, rawResId: Int) {
        try {
            val adventuresDirUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(
                parentUri,
                DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(parentUri) + "/Adventures"
            )
            val existingFiles = getFileNamesInFolder(adventuresDirUri)
            if (existingFiles.contains(fileName)) return
            val fileUri = DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                requireContext().contentResolver,
                adventuresDirUri,
                "application/json",
                fileName
            )
            if (fileUri != null) {
                val jsonString = resources.openRawResource(rawResId)
                    .bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
                requireContext().contentResolver.openOutputStream(fileUri)?.use { outputStream ->
                    outputStream.write(jsonString.toByteArray())
                }
                Logger.log(requireContext(), "Тестовое приключение $fileName скопировано")
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(requireContext(), "Ошибка копирования $fileName: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    private fun getFileNamesInFolder(folderUri: Uri): List<String> {
        val names = mutableListOf<String>()
        val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
            folderUri,
            DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(folderUri)
        )
        val cursor = requireContext().contentResolver.query(childrenUri, null, null, null, null)
        cursor?.use {
            while (it.moveToNext()) {
                val name = it.getString(it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME))
                names.add(name)
            }
        }
        return names
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView()
        _binding = null
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import android.provider.OpenableColumns
import android.widget.Toast

object AdventureImportHelper {

    /**
     * Копирует выбранный JSON-файл в папку Adventures приложения.
     * Возвращает имя сохранённого файла или null при ошибке.
     */
    fun importAdventure(context: Context, sourceUri: Uri): String? {
        return try {
            val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", 0)
            val folderUriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null)
            if (folderUriString == null) {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Папка не выбрана", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return null
            }
            val folderUri = Uri.parse(folderUriString)

            val sourceName = context.contentResolver.query(sourceUri, null, null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
                if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                    val idx = cursor.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
                    if (idx >= 0) cursor.getString(idx) else "imported_adventure.json"
                } else "imported_adventure.json"
            } ?: "imported_adventure.json"

            val adventuresDirUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(
                folderUri,
                DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri) + "/Adventures"
            )
            val destUri = DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                context.contentResolver,
                adventuresDirUri,
                "application/json",
                sourceName
            )
            if (destUri != null) {
                context.contentResolver.openInputStream(sourceUri)?.use { input ->
                    context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(destUri)?.use { output ->
                        input.copyTo(output)
                    }
                }
                Logger.log(context, "Приключение импортировано: $sourceName")
                Toast.makeText(context, "Приключение импортировано: $sourceName", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                sourceName
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Не удалось создать файл", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                null
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Ошибка импорта: ${e.message}")
            Toast.makeText(context, "Ошибка импорта: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            null
        }
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import android.content.Context
import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorDraft
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorTag
import com.myapp.adventure.data.deepCopy

object EditorDraftManager {

    private const val PREFS_NAME = "editor_draft_prefs"
    private const val KEY_DRAFT = "draft_json"

    private val gson = Gson()

    fun saveDraft(
        context: Context,
        title: String,
        author: String,
        description: String,
        initialStateTags: List<EditorTag>,
        scenes: List<EditorScene>
    ) {
        try {
            val draft = EditorDraft(
                title = title,
                author = author,
                description = description,
                initialStateTags = initialStateTags.map { it.copy() },
                scenes = scenes.map { it.deepCopy() }
            )
            context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().putString(KEY_DRAFT, gson.toJson(draft)).apply()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Ошибка сохранения черновика: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    fun loadDraft(context: Context): EditorDraft? {
        val json = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getString(KEY_DRAFT, null) ?: return null
        return try {
            gson.fromJson(json, EditorDraft::class.java)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Ошибка чтения черновика: ${e.message}")
            clearDraft(context)
            null
        }
    }

    fun clearDraft(context: Context) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().remove(KEY_DRAFT).apply()
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/utils/FontManager.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.net.Uri
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream

object FontManager {

    private const val PREFS_NAME = "font_prefs"
    private const val KEY_SELECTED_FONT = "selected_font"
    private const val KEY_CUSTOM_FONTS = "custom_fonts"
    private const val KEY_FONT_SCALE = "font_scale"
    private const val FONTS_DIR = "fonts"

    /** Доступные масштабы: отображаемое имя → множитель. */
    val FONT_SCALES: List<Pair<String, Float>> = listOf(
        "Мелкий"   to 0.85f,
        "Обычный"  to 1.0f,
        "Крупный"  to 1.15f,
        "Очень крупный" to 1.3f
    )

    fun getFontScale(context: Context): Float {
        val scale = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getFloat(KEY_FONT_SCALE, 1.0f)
        return FONT_SCALES.firstOrNull { it.second == scale }?.second
            ?: FONT_SCALES.minByOrNull { kotlin.math.abs(it.second - scale) }!!.second
    }

    fun setFontScale(context: Context, scale: Float) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().putFloat(KEY_FONT_SCALE, scale).apply()
        Logger.log(context, "Масштаб шрифта: $scale")
    }

    fun getAvailableFonts(context: Context): List<String> {
        val fonts = mutableListOf("По умолчанию", "Bad Script", "Caveat")
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        fonts.addAll(prefs.getStringSet(KEY_CUSTOM_FONTS, emptySet()) ?: emptySet())
        return fonts
    }

    fun addFont(context: Context, sourceUri: Uri, fileName: String) {
        val fontsDir = File(context.filesDir, FONTS_DIR)
        if (!fontsDir.exists()) fontsDir.mkdirs()
        val destFile = File(fontsDir, fileName)
        context.contentResolver.openInputStream(sourceUri)?.use { input ->
            FileOutputStream(destFile).use { output -> input.copyTo(output) }
        }
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val customFonts = prefs.getStringSet(KEY_CUSTOM_FONTS, emptySet())?.toMutableSet() ?: mutableSetOf()
        customFonts.add(fileName)
        prefs.edit().putStringSet(KEY_CUSTOM_FONTS, customFonts).apply()
        Logger.log(context, "Шрифт добавлен: $fileName")
    }

    fun getTypeface(context: Context, fontName: String): Typeface = when (fontName) {
        "По умолчанию" -> Typeface.DEFAULT
        "Bad Script" -> Typeface.createFromAsset(context.assets, "fonts/BadScript-Regular.ttf")
        "Caveat" -> Typeface.createFromAsset(context.assets, "fonts/Caveat-Regular.ttf")
        else -> {
            val fontFile = File(context.filesDir, "$FONTS_DIR/$fontName")
            if (fontFile.exists()) Typeface.createFromFile(fontFile) else Typeface.DEFAULT
        }
    }

    /** Применяет шрифт и текущий масштаб ко всему дереву View. */
    fun applyFontToViewTree(view: View, fontName: String, context: Context) {
        val scale = getFontScale(context)
        applyRecursive(view, fontName, scale, context)
    }

    private fun applyRecursive(view: View, fontName: String, scale: Float, context: Context) {
        if (view is TextView) {
            view.typeface = getTypeface(context, fontName)
            applyScaleToTextView(view, scale)
        } else if (view is ViewGroup) {
            for (i in 0 until view.childCount) {
                applyRecursive(view.getChildAt(i), fontName, scale, context)
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Масштабирует размер текста относительно исходного, сохранённого в теге.
     * Текст задаётся в SP, поэтому соблюдаются системные настройки доступности.
     */
    private fun applyScaleToTextView(tv: TextView, scale: Float) {
        // Исходный размер храним в SP, а не в PX, чтобы не зависеть от плотности экрана
        val originalSp = (tv.getTag(R.id.original_text_size) as? Float)
            ?: tv.textSize.let { px ->
                val sp = px / tv.resources.displayMetrics.scaledDensity
                tv.setTag(R.id.original_text_size, sp)
                sp
            }
        tv.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, originalSp * scale)
    }

    fun setSelectedFont(context: Context, fontName: String) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().putString(KEY_SELECTED_FONT, fontName).apply()
        Logger.log(context, "Выбран шрифт: $fontName")
    }

    fun getSelectedFont(context: Context): String {
        return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getString(KEY_SELECTED_FONT, "По умолчанию") ?: "По умолчанию"
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/utils/Logger.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import androidx.core.net.toUri
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.time.LocalDateTime
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/**
 * Thread-safe, non-blocking file logger.
 *
 * - [log] only appends to an in-memory queue and schedules a batched flush.
 *   Never touches disk on the calling thread.
 * - Batched flush writes to the file with `OutputStream(uri, "wa")` (append).
 *   No read-modify-write cycle, so cost per flush is O(buffered lines), not O(file size).
 * - Timestamps use [Locale.ROOT] and an immutable [DateTimeFormatter], so logs
 *   are stable across locale changes and safe from multiple threads.
 * - The log file [Uri] is resolved once and cached; reset on [init] or when
 *   the file disappears.
 *
 * Read/clear are `suspend` and run on [Dispatchers.IO]; callers must not
 * assume they can be called from the main thread without dispatching.
 */
object Logger {

    private const val PREFS_NAME = "adventure_prefs"
    private const val KEY_LOGGING_ENABLED = "logging_enabled"
    private const val LOG_FILE_NAME = "debug_log.txt"
    private const val FLUSH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 2_000L
    private const val MAX_BUFFER_LINES = 100

    private val dateFormatter: DateTimeFormatter =
        DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.ROOT)

    @Volatile private var baseUri: Uri? = null
    @Volatile private var enabled: Boolean = false

    /** Cached log file URI. */
    @Volatile private var logFileUri: Uri? = null

    /** In-memory buffer of lines waiting to be flushed. */
    private val pendingLines = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<String>()

    /** Serialises flushes: at most one write to disk at a time. */
    private val flushMutex = Mutex()

    /** True while a debounced flush is already scheduled. */
    private val flushScheduled = AtomicBoolean(false)

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)

    // ==================== Lifecycle ====================

    fun init(context: Context, folderUriString: String) {
        baseUri = folderUriString.toUri()
        enabled = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getBoolean(KEY_LOGGING_ENABLED, true)
        // Base URI may have changed; cached file URI is no longer valid.
        logFileUri = null
    }

    fun setEnabled(context: Context, enabled: Boolean) {
        this.enabled = enabled
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putBoolean(KEY_LOGGING_ENABLED, enabled)
            .apply()
        if (!enabled) {
            // Don't silently drop pending lines when logging is disabled.
            val appContext = context.applicationContext
            scope.launch { flushLocked(appContext) }
        }
    }

    // ==================== Log (non-blocking) ====================

    /**
     * Fast, thread-safe, non-blocking. Appends [message] to the in-memory
     * buffer and schedules a batched flush. Never performs disk I/O on the
     * calling thread, so it is safe to call from `onSensorChanged`,
     * `onStartCommand`, UI callbacks, etc.
     */
    fun log(context: Context, message: String) {
        if (!enabled || baseUri == null) return
        val timestamp = dateFormatter.format(LocalDateTime.now())
        pendingLines.add("$timestamp $message")

        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        if (pendingLines.size >= MAX_BUFFER_LINES) {
            // Buffer is filling up fast — flush now, no debounce.
            scope.launch { flushLocked(appContext) }
        } else {
            scheduleFlush(appContext)
        }
    }

    private fun scheduleFlush(appContext: Context) {
        if (!flushScheduled.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        scope.launch {
            delay(FLUSH_DEBOUNCE_MS)
            flushScheduled.set(false)
            flushLocked(appContext)
        }
    }

    /** Force-drain the buffer to disk. Safe to call from any thread. */
    suspend fun flush(context: Context) {
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { flushLocked(appContext) }
    }

    // ==================== Read / clear (suspend) ====================

    /**
     * Returns the full log content. Flushes the buffer first so the caller
     * sees the latest lines. Runs on [Dispatchers.IO].
     */
    suspend fun getLogContent(context: Context): String {
        if (baseUri == null) return "Логирование не настроено"
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            flushLocked(appContext)
            val fileUri = getOrCreateLogFile(appContext)
                ?: return@withContext "Файл лога недоступен"
            try {
                appContext.contentResolver.openInputStream(fileUri)
                    ?.bufferedReader()
                    ?.use { it.readText() }
                    ?: "Лог пуст"
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                "Ошибка чтения: ${e.message}"
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Drops all pending lines and truncates the log file to zero bytes.
     * Runs on [Dispatchers.IO].
     */
    suspend fun clearLog(context: Context) {
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            pendingLines.clear()
            val fileUri = getOrCreateLogFile(appContext) ?: return@withContext
            try {
                appContext.contentResolver.openOutputStream(fileUri, "wt")?.use {
                    it.write(ByteArray(0))
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) {
            }
        }
    }

    // ==================== Internal ====================

    /**
     * Drains [pendingLines] and appends them to the log file in a single
     * open/write/close. OutputStream opened in append mode ("wa"), so the
     * file is never read back. Must be called under [flushMutex].
     */
    private suspend fun flushLocked(context: Context) {
        flushMutex.withLock {
            if (pendingLines.isEmpty()) return
            val fileUri = getOrCreateLogFile(context) ?: return

            // Snapshot and clear while under lock to keep ordering stable.
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            while (true) {
                val line = pendingLines.poll() ?: break
                sb.append(line).append('\n')
            }
            if (sb.isEmpty()) return

            try {
                context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(fileUri, "wa")?.use { out ->
                    out.write(sb.toString().toByteArray())
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Lines are already dropped from the buffer; worst case we lose logs.
                android.util.Log.e("Logger", "Failed to flush log lines: ${e.message}")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun getOrCreateLogFile(context: Context): Uri? {
        // Fast path: cached URI is still usable.
        logFileUri?.let { return it }

        val folderUri = baseUri ?: return null
        val parentDocId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri)
        val rootDocUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, parentDocId)

        val childrenUri =
            DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(folderUri, parentDocId)
        val cursor = context.contentResolver.query(childrenUri, null, null, null, null)
        cursor?.use {
            while (it.moveToNext()) {
                val name = it.getString(
                    it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
                )
                if (name == LOG_FILE_NAME) {
                    val docId = it.getString(
                        it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
                    )
                    val uri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, docId)
                    logFileUri = uri
                    return uri
                }
            }
        }

        return try {
            val created = DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                context.contentResolver,
                rootDocUri,
                "text/plain",
                LOG_FILE_NAME
            )
            logFileUri = created
            created
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
}


================================================
FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/utils/ProgressManager.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken
import com.myapp.adventure.data.ProgressData
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/**
 * Persists per-adventure progress in `progress.json` inside the adventure folder.
 *
 * Design:
 * - The whole progress map is kept in memory after the first read. Reads never hit the disk again.
 * - [saveProgress] and [deleteProgress] only update the in-memory cache and schedule a batched flush.
 * - [flush] forces the cache to disk; callers use it at `onStop` to guarantee persistence.
 * - Disk is written at most once per [SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS] when progress changes.
 * - Logging happens only on real state changes (save with different value, delete of existing entry,
 *   flush that actually wrote) to keep the log meaningful.
 */
object ProgressManager {

    private const val PROGRESS_FILE_NAME = "progress.json"
    private const val SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 2_000L

    private val gson = Gson()
    private val mutex = Mutex()
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)

    /** Guards reads/writes of [cache] and [dirty]. */
    private val cacheLock = Any()

    /** In-memory copy of progress.json keyed by adventure file name. */
    @Volatile private var cache: Map<String, ProgressData>? = null

    /** True when [cache] has unsaved changes that must be flushed. */
    @Volatile private var dirty = false

    /** Set while a debounced flush is already scheduled. */
    private val flushScheduled = AtomicBoolean(false)

    // ==================== Public API ====================

    /**
     * Returns saved progress for [adventureFileUri], or null if none.
     *
     * The first call reads the whole progress.json once; subsequent calls are pure in-memory.
     * Prefer [warmUp] during app startup so this fast path is already primed.
     */
    fun loadProgress(context: Context, adventureFileUri: Uri): ProgressData? {
        val fileName = getFileNameFromUri(context, adventureFileUri) ?: return null
        ensureLoaded(context)
        return cache?.get(fileName)
    }

    /**
     * Schedules a save of [progress] for [adventureFileUri]. Does not touch the disk
     * synchronously; a batched flush happens within [SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS] or at the next [flush].
     */
    fun saveProgress(context: Context, adventureFileUri: Uri, progress: ProgressData) {
        val fileName = getFileNameFromUri(context, adventureFileUri) ?: return
        val logged = synchronized(cacheLock) {
            ensureLoaded(context)
            val updated = (cache ?: emptyMap()).toMutableMap()
            val previous = updated[fileName]
            if (previous == progress) return  // No-op, keep cache clean.
            updated[fileName] = progress
            cache = updated
            dirty = true
            true
        }
        if (!logged) return

        Logger.log(
            context,
            "Progress saved for $fileName: chapter ${progress.currentChapterIndex + 1}, " +
                    "scene '${progress.currentSceneId}', gate=${progress.isGateActive}, " +
                    "remaining=${progress.remainingSteps}, lastAbsAtSave=${progress.lastAbsoluteAtSave}"
        )

        scheduleFlush(context.applicationContext)
    }

    /** Removes progress for [adventureFileUri]. No-op if nothing was saved. */
    fun deleteProgress(context: Context, adventureFileUri: Uri) {
        val fileName = getFileNameFromUri(context, adventureFileUri) ?: return
        val removed = synchronized(cacheLock) {
            ensureLoaded(context)
            val current = cache ?: return
            if (!current.containsKey(fileName)) return
            val updated = current.toMutableMap()
            updated.remove(fileName)
            cache = updated
            dirty = true
            true
        }
        if (!removed) return

        Logger.log(context, "Progress deleted for $fileName")
        scheduleFlush(context.applicationContext)
    }

    /**
     * Forces the current in-memory cache to disk. Call this from `onStop`
     * ("left the foreground") rather than `onPause` (which fires before many transient states).
     */
    suspend fun flush(context: Context) {
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { flushLocked(appContext) }
    }

    /**
     * Reads progress.json into the in-memory cache if not already loaded.
     * Call once during startup to avoid a synchronous disk read on a hot path.
     */
    suspend fun warmUp(context: Context) {
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { ensureLoaded(appContext) }
    }

    // ==================== Internal ====================

    private fun ensureLoaded(context: Context) {
        if (cache != null) return
        synchronized(cacheLock) {
            if (cache != null) return
            cache = readFromDisk(context)
        }
    }

    private fun readFromDisk(context: Context): Map<String, ProgressData> {
        val fileUri = getProgressFileUri(context) ?: return emptyMap()
        return try {
            val json = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(fileUri)
                ?.bufferedReader()
                ?.use { it.readText() }
            if (json.isNullOrBlank()) {
                Logger.log(context, "Progress cache loaded: empty file")
                emptyMap()
            } else {
                val type = object : TypeToken<Map<String, ProgressData>>() {}.type
                val map = gson.fromJson<Map<String, ProgressData>>(json, type) ?: emptyMap()
                Logger.log(context, "Progress cache loaded: ${map.size} entries")
                map
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to read progress.json: ${e.message}")
            emptyMap()
        }
    }

    private fun scheduleFlush(appContext: Context) {
        if (!flushScheduled.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        scope.launch {
            delay(SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS)
            flushScheduled.set(false)
            flushLocked(appContext)
        }
    }

    /** Writes the cache to disk if dirty. Safe for concurrent calls (serialised by [mutex]). */
    private suspend fun flushLocked(context: Context) {
        mutex.withLock {
            val snapshot: Map<String, ProgressData>
            synchronized(cacheLock) {
                if (!dirty) return
                snapshot = cache ?: return
            }
            val fileUri = getOrCreateProgressFile(context)
            if (fileUri == null) {
                Logger.log(context, "Cannot create or access progress.json")
                return
            }
            try {
                val json = gson.toJson(snapshot)
                context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(fileUri, "wt")?.use { out ->
                    out.write(json.toByteArray())
                }
                synchronized(cacheLock) { dirty = false }
                Logger.log(context, "Progress cache flushed: ${snapshot.size} entries")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Logger.log(context, "Failed to write progress.json: ${e.message}")
            }
        }
    }

    // ==================== File access ====================

    private fun getOrCreateProgressFile(context: Context): Uri? {
        val existing = getProgressFileUri(context)
        if (existing != null) return existing
        val folderUri = getBaseFolderUri(context) ?: return null
        val parentDocId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri)
        val rootDocUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, parentDocId)
        return try {
            DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                context.contentResolver,
                rootDocUri,
                "application/json",
                PROGRESS_FILE_NAME
            )
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to create progress.json: ${e.message}")
            null
        }
    }

    private fun getProgressFileUri(context: Context): Uri? {
        val folderUri = getBaseFolderUri(context) ?: return null
        val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
            folderUri,
            DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri)
        )
        val cursor = context.contentResolver.query(childrenUri, null, null, null, null)
        cursor?.use {
            while (it.moveToNext()) {
                val name = it.getString(
                    it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
                )
                if (name == PROGRESS_FILE_NAME) {
                    val docId = it.getString(
                        it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
                    )
                    return DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, docId)
                }
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun getFileNameFromUri(context: Context, uri: Uri): String? {
        val docId = DocumentsContract.getDocumentId(uri)
        return docId.substringAfterLast("/").substringAfterLast(":")
    }

    private fun getBaseFolderUri(context: Context): Uri? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val uriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null) ?: return null
        return Uri.parse(uriString)
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.SearchFieldType
import com.myapp.adventure.data.SearchResult

object SearchService {

    private const val CONTEXT_LEN = 30
    private const val MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2

    fun search(
        scenes: List<EditorScene>,
        query: String,
        searchInTitles: Boolean,
        searchInTexts: Boolean,
        searchInChoices: Boolean,
        searchInTags: Boolean
    ): List<SearchResult> {
        val trimmed = query.trim()
        if (trimmed.length < MIN_QUERY_LENGTH) return emptyList()
        val qLower = trimmed.lowercase()

        val results = mutableListOf<SearchResult>()

        for (scene in scenes) {
            val displayTitle = scene.title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" }

            if (searchInTitles && scene.title.isNotEmpty()) {
                val positions = findAllPositions(scene.title, qLower)
                if (positions.isNotEmpty()) {
                    results += makeResult(
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        sceneTitle = displayTitle,
                        fieldType = SearchFieldType.SCENE_TITLE,
                        detail = "Заголовок",
                        sourceText = scene.title,
                        positions = positions,
                        matchLen = trimmed.length
                    )
                }
            }

            if (searchInTexts && scene.text.isNotEmpty()) {
                val positions = findAllPositions(scene.text, qLower)
                if (positions.isNotEmpty()) {
                    results += makeResult(
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        sceneTitle = displayTitle,
                        fieldType = SearchFieldType.SCENE_TEXT,
                        detail = "Текст сцены",
                        sourceText = scene.text,
                        positions = positions,
                        matchLen = trimmed.length
                    )
                }
            }

            if (searchInChoices) {
                scene.choices.forEachIndexed { idx, choice ->
                    if (choice.text.isEmpty()) return@forEachIndexed
                    val positions = findAllPositions(choice.text, qLower)
                    if (positions.isNotEmpty()) {
                        results += makeResult(
                            sceneUid = scene.uid,
                            sceneTitle = displayTitle,
                            fieldType = SearchFieldType.CHOICE_TEXT,
                            detail = "Выбор #${idx + 1}",
                            sourceText = choice.text,
                            positions = positions,
                            matchLen = trimmed.length
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            if (searchInTags) {
                scene.tags.forEach { tag ->
                    if (tag.name.isEmpty()) return@forEach
                    val positions = findAllPositions(tag.name, qLower)
                    if (positions.isNotEmpty()) {
                        results += makeResult(
                            sceneUid = scene.uid,
                            sceneTitle = displayTitle,
                            fieldType = SearchFieldType.TAG_NAME,
                            detail = "Метка",
                            sourceText = tag.name,
                            positions = positions,
                            matchLen = trimmed.length
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return results
    }

    private fun findAllPositions(text: String, qLower: String): List<Int> {
        val positions = mutableListOf<Int>()
        val textLower = text.lowercase()
        var idx = textLower.indexOf(qLower)
        while (idx >= 0) {
            positions += idx
            idx = textLower.indexOf(qLower, idx + 1)
        }
        return positions
    }

    private fun makeResult(
        sceneUid: String,
        sceneTitle: String,
        fieldType: SearchFieldType,
        detail: String,
        sourceText: String,
        positions: List<Int>,
        matchLen: Int
    ): SearchResult {
        val firstPos = positions.first()

        val beforeStart = (firstPos - CONTEXT_LEN).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val before = sourceText.substring(beforeStart, firstPos).replace('\n', ' ')

        val match = sourceText.substring(firstPos, firstPos + matchLen)

        val afterEnd = (firstPos + matchLen + CONTEXT_LEN).coerceAtMost(sourceText.length)
        val after = sourceText.substring(firstPos + matchLen, afterEnd).replace('\n', ' ')

        return SearchResult(
            sceneUid = sceneUid,
            sceneTitle = sceneTitle,
            fieldType = fieldType,
            detail = detail,
            contextBefore = before,
            match = match,
            contextAfter = after,
            totalMatchesInField = positions.size,
            charOffset = firstPos
        )
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/utils/StepHistoryManager.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.google.gson.JsonArray
import com.google.gson.JsonElement
import com.google.gson.JsonParser
import com.myapp.adventure.data.StepBucket
import com.myapp.adventure.data.StepHistoryData
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter

/**
 * Owns the step history. Single writer, in-memory cache, batched disk flush.
 *
 * Data model:
 * - [StepHistoryData.buckets] — up to 30 daily deltas, oldest first, trimmed automatically.
 * - [StepHistoryData.totalStepsAllTime] — monotonic counter that never trims.
 *
 * Public API for gameplay:
 * - [getTotalSteps]          — all-time monotonic counter.
 * - [getTodaySteps]          — today's delta.
 * - [getLastNDaysSum]        — rolling window sum (7 / 30 days, achievements).
 * - [getDailyBuckets]        — last N days as a list (statistics screen).
 * - [recordDelta]            — the only writer entry point, source-agnostic.
 * - [flush]                  — force-persist.
 *
 * Future features (achievements, step-gated choices, adventure unlocks) must read
 * history through the public getters above — never touch files or [StepCounterService].
 * TODO(feature:achievements): a StepAchievementEngine will subscribe to history changes
 *   (e.g. an in-process callback invoked from [recordDelta]) and evaluate rules like
 *   "≥50 000 steps in the last 7 days".
 */
object StepHistoryManager {

    private const val HISTORY_FILE_NAME = "step_history.json"
    private const val MAX_DAYS = 30
    private const val SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 10_000L

    private val gson = Gson()
    private val dateFormatter: DateTimeFormatter = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE
    private val mutex = Mutex()

    // ----- In-memory cache -----

    @Volatile private var cache: StepHistoryData = StepHistoryData()
    @Volatile private var cacheLoaded = false
    @Volatile private var lastSaveAt: Long = 0L

    // ==================== Public API ====================

    /** Total steps ever recorded by the app (monotonic, independent of buckets). */
    fun getTotalSteps(context: Context): Long {
        ensureLoaded(context)
        return cache.totalStepsAllTime
    }

    /** Steps recorded today (local date). */
    fun getTodaySteps(context: Context): Int {
        ensureLoaded(context)
        val today = LocalDate.now().format(dateFormatter)
        return cache.buckets.firstOrNull { it.date == today }?.steps ?: 0
    }

    /** Sum of the last [days] buckets (including today). */
    fun getLastNDaysSum(context: Context, days: Int): Int {
        if (days <= 0) return 0
        ensureLoaded(context)
        val cutoff = LocalDate.now()
            .minusDays((days - 1).toLong())
            .format(dateFormatter)
        return cache.buckets
            .filter { it.date >= cutoff }
            .sumOf { it.steps }
    }

    /**
     * Last [lastNDays] buckets, oldest first, padded with zero-step entries
     * for days without data. Length is exactly [lastNDays].
     */
    fun getDailyBuckets(context: Context, lastNDays: Int): List<StepBucket> {
        if (lastNDays <= 0) return emptyList()
        ensureLoaded(context)
        val today = LocalDate.now()
        val result = ArrayList<StepBucket>(lastNDays)
        for (i in (lastNDays - 1) downTo 0) {
            val date = today.minusDays(i.toLong()).format(dateFormatter)
            val existing = cache.buckets.firstOrNull { it.date == date }
            result.add(existing ?: StepBucket(date, 0))
        }
        return result
    }

    /**
     * Record a delta of [delta] steps for today.
     * Non-positive deltas are ignored. Safe to call from any coroutine context.
     */
    suspend fun recordDelta(context: Context, delta: Int) {
        if (delta <= 0) return
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            mutex.withLock {
                ensureLoaded(appContext)
                applyDelta(appContext, delta)
                maybeFlush(appContext)
            }
        }
    }

    /** Force writing the current in-memory state to disk. */
    suspend fun flush(context: Context) {
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            mutex.withLock {
                ensureLoaded(appContext)
                saveToDisk(appContext, cache)
                lastSaveAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Apply a delta coming from Health Connect.
     *
     * Same semantics as [recordDelta] — increments today's bucket and the
     * monotonic total. Kept as a separate method so callers/logs can
     * distinguish HC-sourced steps.
     */
    suspend fun applyHealthConnectDelta(context: Context, delta: Int) {
        if (delta <= 0) return
        recordDelta(context, delta)
    }

    // ==================== Internal: load / migrate ====================

    private fun ensureLoaded(context: Context) {
        if (cacheLoaded) return
        synchronized(this) {
            if (cacheLoaded) return
            cache = loadFromDisk(context)
            cacheLoaded = true
        }
    }

    private fun loadFromDisk(context: Context): StepHistoryData {
        val fileUri = getHistoryFileUri(context) ?: return StepHistoryData()
        val json: String = try {
            context.contentResolver.openInputStream(fileUri)
                ?.bufferedReader()
                ?.use { it.readText() }
                .orEmpty()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to read step history: ${e.message}")
            return StepHistoryData()
        }
        if (json.isBlank()) return StepHistoryData()

        return try {
            val element = JsonParser.parseString(json)
            when {
                element.isJsonObject -> {
                    // New format: { "totalStepsAllTime": ..., "buckets": [...] }
                    gson.fromJson(element, StepHistoryData::class.java) ?: StepHistoryData()
                }
                element.isJsonArray -> {
                    // Legacy format: [["2026-11-04", 53000], ...] with absolute values
                    migrateLegacyFormat(context, element.asJsonArray)
                }
                else -> StepHistoryData()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to parse step history: ${e.message}")
            StepHistoryData()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Convert legacy [["date", absoluteSteps], ...] to the new delta model.
     *
     * First bucket gets steps=0 because we don't know how many steps happened
     * before the first recorded value. [totalStepsAllTime] is set to the last
     * absolute reading — the closest approximation of "steps since phone boot",
     * which the user perceives as "all steps".
     */
    private fun migrateLegacyFormat(context: Context, array: JsonArray): StepHistoryData {
        val entries = mutableListOf<Pair<String, Int>>()
        for (el in array) {
            if (!el.isJsonArray) continue
            val pair = el.asJsonArray
            val date = safeString(pair, 0) ?: continue
            val abs = safeInt(pair, 1) ?: continue
            entries.add(date to abs)
        }
        entries.sortBy { it.first }

        val buckets = mutableListOf<StepBucket>()
        var prevAbs: Int? = null
        var lastAbs: Int = 0
        for ((date, abs) in entries) {
            val delta = if (prevAbs != null) (abs - prevAbs).coerceAtLeast(0) else 0
            buckets.add(StepBucket(date, delta))
            prevAbs = abs
            lastAbs = abs
        }
        val trimmed = trimBuckets(buckets)
        val total = lastAbs.toLong()

        Logger.log(
            context,
            "Migrated legacy step history: ${buckets.size} buckets, total=$total"
        )
        return StepHistoryData(totalStepsAllTime = total, buckets = trimmed)
    }

    private fun safeString(array: JsonArray, index: Int): String? {
        if (index < 0 || index >= array.size()) return null
        val el: JsonElement = array.get(index)
        return if (el.isJsonPrimitive) el.asString else null
    }

    private fun safeInt(array: JsonArray, index: Int): Int? {
        if (index < 0 || index >= array.size()) return null
        val el: JsonElement = array.get(index)
        return if (el.isJsonPrimitive && el.asJsonPrimitive.isNumber) el.asInt else null
    }

    // ==================== Internal: delta application ====================

    /**
     * Apply [delta] to today's bucket and bump the monotonic total.
     * Must be called under [mutex] after [ensureLoaded].
     */
    private fun applyDelta(context: Context, delta: Int) {
        if (delta <= 0) return
        val today = LocalDate.now().format(dateFormatter)
        val buckets = cache.buckets.toMutableList()
        val idx = buckets.indexOfFirst { it.date == today }
        if (idx >= 0) {
            buckets[idx] = buckets[idx].copy(steps = buckets[idx].steps + delta)
        } else {
            buckets.add(StepBucket(today, delta))
        }
        val trimmed = trimBuckets(buckets.sortedBy { it.date })
        cache = StepHistoryData(
            totalStepsAllTime = cache.totalStepsAllTime + delta,
            buckets = trimmed
        )
    }

    private fun trimBuckets(buckets: List<StepBucket>): List<StepBucket> {
        if (buckets.size <= MAX_DAYS) return buckets
        return buckets
            .sortedByDescending { it.date }
            .take(MAX_DAYS)
            .sortedBy { it.date }
    }

    // ==================== Internal: persistence ====================

    private fun maybeFlush(context: Context) {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (now - lastSaveAt >= SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS) {
            saveToDisk(context, cache)
            lastSaveAt = now
        }
    }

    private fun saveToDisk(context: Context, data: StepHistoryData) {
        val fileUri = getOrCreateHistoryFile(context)
        if (fileUri == null) {
            Logger.log(context, "Cannot save step history: no history file")
            return
        }
        try {
            val json = gson.toJson(data)
            context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(fileUri, "wt")?.use {
                it.write(json.toByteArray())
            }
            Logger.log(
                context,
                "Step history saved: ${data.buckets.size} buckets, total=${data.totalStepsAllTime}"
            )
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to save step history: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    // ==================== Internal: file access ====================

    private fun getHistoryFileUri(context: Context): Uri? {
        val folderUri = getBaseFolderUri(context) ?: return null
        val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
            folderUri,
            DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri)
        )
        val cursor = context.contentResolver.query(childrenUri, null, null, null, null)
        cursor?.use {
            while (it.moveToNext()) {
                val name = it.getString(
                    it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
                )
                if (name == HISTORY_FILE_NAME) {
                    val docId = it.getString(
                        it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
                    )
                    return DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, docId)
                }
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun getOrCreateHistoryFile(context: Context): Uri? {
        val folderUri = getBaseFolderUri(context) ?: return null
        getHistoryFileUri(context)?.let { return it }

        val parentDocId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri)
        val rootDocUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, parentDocId)
        return try {
            DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                context.contentResolver,
                rootDocUri,
                "application/json",
                HISTORY_FILE_NAME
            )
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to create step_history.json: ${e.message}")
            null
        }
    }

    private fun getBaseFolderUri(context: Context): Uri? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val uriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null) ?: return null
        return Uri.parse(uriString)
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/utils/StoryStatsService.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import com.myapp.adventure.data.ChapterStats
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.StoryStats
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

object StoryStatsService {

    /** Средняя скорость чтения, слов в минуту. */
    private const val WORDS_PER_MINUTE = 200.0

    /** Дополнительное время на обдумывание одного выбора, секунд. */
    private const val SECONDS_PER_CHOICE = 20

    fun calculate(scenes: List<EditorScene>): StoryStats {
        if (scenes.isEmpty()) {
            return StoryStats(
                totalScenes = 0,
                totalWords = 0,
                totalChoices = 0,
                totalChapters = 0,
                estimatedReadingMinutes = 0,
                avgWordsPerScene = 0,
                longestSceneTitle = "",
                longestSceneWords = 0,
                shortestSceneTitle = "",
                shortestSceneWords = 0,
                chapters = emptyList()
            )
        }

        val perSceneWords = scenes.map { countWords(it.text) }
        val totalWords = perSceneWords.sum()
        val totalChoices = scenes.sumOf { it.choices.size }

        // Самая длинная и самая короткая сцены
        var longestIdx = 0
        var shortestIdx = 0
        for (i in perSceneWords.indices) {
            if (perSceneWords[i] > perSceneWords[longestIdx]) longestIdx = i
            if (perSceneWords[i] < perSceneWords[shortestIdx]) shortestIdx = i
        }

        // Разбивка по главам — тот же алгоритм, что в buildAdventure()
        val chapters = buildChapterGroups(scenes)
        val chapterStats = chapters.mapIndexed { idx, group ->
            val isLast = idx == chapters.size - 1
            val wordCount = group.sumOf { countWords(it.text) }
            val choiceCount = group.sumOf { it.choices.size }
            // b2 TODO: gates can now sit anywhere in a chapter, not
            // just on the last scene. This heuristic (last scene's
            // gate) is the old behaviour. A proper "sum of gates in
            // chapter" or "first gate in chapter" goes into a polish
            // pass; for now it keeps the stats close enough.
            val requiredSteps = if (!isLast) group.last().gateRequiredSteps else 0
            ChapterStats(
                index = idx + 1,
                sceneCount = group.size,
                wordCount = wordCount,
                choiceCount = choiceCount,
                requiredSteps = requiredSteps,
                isLast = isLast
            )
        }

        // Время чтения: слова + обдумывание выборов
        val readingSeconds = (totalWords / WORDS_PER_MINUTE * 60.0).roundToInt() +
                totalChoices * SECONDS_PER_CHOICE
        val readingMinutes = (readingSeconds / 60.0).roundToInt()

        val avgWords = (totalWords.toDouble() / scenes.size).roundToInt()

        return StoryStats(
            totalScenes = scenes.size,
            totalWords = totalWords,
            totalChoices = totalChoices,
            totalChapters = chapters.size,
            estimatedReadingMinutes = readingMinutes,
            avgWordsPerScene = avgWords,
            longestSceneTitle = scenes[longestIdx].title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" },
            longestSceneWords = perSceneWords[longestIdx],
            shortestSceneTitle = scenes[shortestIdx].title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" },
            shortestSceneWords = perSceneWords[shortestIdx],
            chapters = chapterStats
        )
    }

    /**
     * Считает слова: разбивает по пробельным символам, отбрасывает пустые.
     * Подходит для русского и большинства европейских языков.
     */
    private fun countWords(text: String): Int {
        if (text.isBlank()) return 0
        return text.split(Regex("\\s+")).count { it.isNotBlank() }
    }

    private fun buildChapterGroups(scenes: List<EditorScene>): List<List<EditorScene>> {
        val groups = mutableListOf<List<EditorScene>>()
        var current = mutableListOf<EditorScene>()
        for (scene in scenes) {
            current.add(scene)
            if (scene.isChapterEnd || scene == scenes.last()) {
                groups.add(current.toList())
                current = mutableListOf()
            }
        }
        if (current.isNotEmpty()) groups.add(current)
        return groups
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/utils/StoryValidator.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.IssueSeverity
import com.myapp.adventure.data.PlayerState
import com.myapp.adventure.data.TagCategory
import com.myapp.adventure.data.ValidationIssue

object StoryValidator {

    fun validate(
        scenes: List<EditorScene>,
        initialState: PlayerState? = null
    ): List<ValidationIssue> {
        val issues = mutableListOf<ValidationIssue>()
        if (scenes.isEmpty()) return issues

        val uidById = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
        scenes.forEach { if (it.id.isNotEmpty()) uidById[it.id] = it.uid }

        // Собираем все имена меток, которые где-то устанавливаются:
        // - в scene.tags (положительные)
        // - в choice.tags (положительные)
        // - в initialState.flags (все имена)
        // - в initialState.stats (только != 0)
        val establishable = collectEstablishableNames(scenes, initialState)

        // ---------- ERROR: битые ссылки и пустые выборы ----------
        for (scene in scenes) {
            val sceneName = scene.title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" }
            for ((choiceIdx, choice) in scene.choices.withIndex()) {
                val choiceLabel = choice.text.ifBlank { "(без текста)" }

                if (choice.text.isBlank()) {
                    issues += ValidationIssue(
                        severity = IssueSeverity.ERROR,
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        title = "Пустой текст выбора",
                        description = "Сцена «$sceneName», вариант #${choiceIdx + 1}: текст не заполнен"
                    )
                }
                if (choice.nextSceneId.isBlank()) {
                    issues += ValidationIssue(
                        severity = IssueSeverity.ERROR,
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        title = "Выбор без перехода",
                        description = "Сцена «$sceneName», вариант «$choiceLabel» никуда не ведёт"
                    )
                } else if (choice.nextSceneId !in uidById) {
                    issues += ValidationIssue(
                        severity = IssueSeverity.ERROR,
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        title = "Битая ссылка",
                        description = "Сцена «$sceneName», вариант «$choiceLabel» ведёт на несуществующую сцену «${choice.nextSceneId}»"
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // ---------- WARNING: условие ссылается на неустанавливаемую метку ----------
        for (scene in scenes) {
            val sceneName = scene.title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" }
            for (choice in scene.choices) {
                val cond = choice.conditionTag.trim()
                if (cond.isEmpty()) continue
                val flagName = extractHasFlagName(cond) ?: continue
                if (flagName !in establishable) {
                    issues += ValidationIssue(
                        severity = IssueSeverity.WARNING,
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        title = "Условие на неустанавливаемую метку",
                        description = "Сцена «$sceneName», вариант «${choice.text.ifBlank { "(без текста)" }}»: " +
                                "условие «$cond» ссылается на метку «$flagName», которая нигде не устанавливается " +
                                "ни в сценах, ни в эффектах выборов, ни в начальном состоянии."
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        // ---------- ERROR: снятие ITEM/HEALTH, которое нигде не устанавливается ----------
        val positiveEst = collectPositiveItemHealthNames(scenes, initialState)
        for (scene in scenes) {
            val sceneName = scene.title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" }

            for (tag in scene.tags) {
                if (tag.name.startsWith("!")) continue
                if (tag.value >= 0) continue
                if (tag.category != TagCategory.ITEM && tag.category != TagCategory.HEALTH) continue
                if (tag.name !in positiveEst) {
                    issues += ValidationIssue(
                        severity = IssueSeverity.ERROR,
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        title = "Снятие неустанавливаемого ресурса",
                        description = "Сцена «$sceneName», метка «${tag.name}» (${tag.value}): уменьшает значение, " +
                                "но «${tag.name}» нигде не устанавливается положительно " +
                                "(ни в начальном состоянии, ни в эффектах сцен/выборов). Игрок не сможет это использовать."
                    )
                }
            }

            for (choice in scene.choices) {
                val choiceLabel = choice.text.ifBlank { "(без текста)" }
                for (tag in choice.tags) {
                    if (tag.name.startsWith("!")) continue
                    if (tag.value >= 0) continue
                    if (tag.category != TagCategory.ITEM && tag.category != TagCategory.HEALTH) continue
                    if (tag.name !in positiveEst) {
                        issues += ValidationIssue(
                            severity = IssueSeverity.ERROR,
                            sceneUid = scene.uid,
                            title = "Снятие неустанавливаемого ресурса",
                            description = "Сцена «$sceneName», выбор «$choiceLabel», метка «${tag.name}» (${tag.value}): " +
                                    "уменьшает значение, но «${tag.name}» нигде не устанавливается положительно. " +
                                    "Игрок не сможет это использовать."
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // ---------- WARNING: смерть и сцена смерти ----------
        val hasDeathScene = scenes.any { it.isDeathScene }
        val hasHealth = hasHealthInStats(scenes, initialState)

        if (hasHealth && !hasDeathScene) {
            issues += ValidationIssue(
                severity = IssueSeverity.WARNING,
                sceneUid = scenes.first().uid,
                title = "Смерть без сцены смерти",
                description = "В истории используется health, но сцена смерти не задана. " +
                        "При наступлении смерти будет показан стандартный экран."
            )
        }

        if (hasDeathScene && !hasHealth) {
            val deathScene = scenes.first { it.isDeathScene }
            issues += ValidationIssue(
                severity = IssueSeverity.WARNING,
                sceneUid = deathScene.uid,
                title = "Сцена смерти без health",
                description = "Сцена смерти задана, но health нигде не используется — " +
                        "смерть никогда не наступит."
            )
        }


        // ---------- WARNING: тупики ----------
        for ((idx, scene) in scenes.withIndex()) {
            if (scene.choices.isEmpty() && !scene.isChapterEnd && idx < scenes.size - 1) {
                issues += ValidationIssue(
                    severity = IssueSeverity.WARNING,
                    sceneUid = scene.uid,
                    title = "Тупик",
                    description = "Сцена «${scene.title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" }}» не имеет вариантов и не отмечена как конец главы. В читалке это завершит главу или историю."
                )
            }
        }

        // ---------- WARNING: шаговые шлюзы ----------
        // b2: gates are per-scene now. `isChapterEnd` is a narrative
        // boundary, not a gate marker — a chapter end without a gate
        // is a legitimate author choice ("this chapter is a natural
        // break, but the next opens immediately"). The old warning
        // "chapter end but 0 steps = auto-open" was only meaningful
        // when chapter end *implied* a gate; that implication is gone.
        // Replaced by: "gate on the very last scene, but the scene is
        // not marked as an ending" — the player will walk the gate,
        // see choices-less scene, and get "🎉 Конец истории" **only
        // if** it was also `is_ending`; otherwise it is a DeadEnd
        // (already a separate analyzer warning). So this warning is
        // now specifically "gate on a terminal scene that is also an
        // ending" — the gate can never be completed, because the
        // scene stops the story first.
        for ((idx, scene) in scenes.withIndex()) {
            if (scene.gateRequiredSteps > 0 && scene.isEnding) {
                issues += ValidationIssue(
                    severity = IssueSeverity.WARNING,
                    sceneUid = scene.uid,
                    title = "Шаговый гейт на сцене-конце истории",
                    description = "Сцена «${scene.title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" }}» " +
                            "помечена как конец игры и одновременно требует " +
                            "${scene.gateRequiredSteps} шагов. Гейт не сработает — " +
                            "читалка остановит историю до того, как шаги будут пройдены."
                )
            }
        }

        // ---------- WARNING: недостижимые сцены ----------
        val reachable = computeReachable(scenes, establishable)
        for ((idx, scene) in scenes.withIndex()) {
            if (idx > 0 && scene.uid !in reachable) {
                issues += ValidationIssue(
                    severity = IssueSeverity.WARNING,
                    sceneUid = scene.uid,
                    title = "Недостижимая сцена",
                    description = "Сцена «${scene.title.ifBlank { "(без названия)" }}» недостижима ни по одной ветке из начала истории."
                )
            }
        }

        return issues
    }

    /**
     * Собирает имена меток, которые где-то устанавливаются:
     * - в scene.tags (положительные, не начинающиеся с «!»)
     * - в choice.tags всех выборов всех сцен
     * - в initialState.flags (все)
     * - в initialState.stats (только те, где значение != 0)
     * Имена с «!» (снятие флага) в множество не попадают.
     */

    /**
     * Собирает имена ITEM/HEALTH-меток, которые где-то устанавливаются в положительное значение:
     * - initialState.stats (значение > 0)
     * - scene.tags / choice.tags с категорией ITEM/HEALTH и value > 0
     */

    /** true, если health где-то встречается (initial_state, эффекты сцен или выборов). */
    private fun hasHealthInStats(
        scenes: List<EditorScene>,
        initialState: PlayerState?
    ): Boolean {
        if ((initialState?.stats?.get("health") ?: -1) >= 0) return true

        for (scene in scenes) {
            if (scene.tags.any { it.name == "health" && it.value != 0 }) return true
            for (choice in scene.choices) {
                if (choice.tags.any { it.name == "health" && it.value != 0 }) return true
            }
        }
        return false
    }


    private fun collectPositiveItemHealthNames(
        scenes: List<EditorScene>,
        initialState: PlayerState?
    ): Set<String> {
        val result = mutableSetOf<String>()

        initialState?.stats?.forEach { (name, value) ->
            if (value > 0) result.add(name)
        }

        fun registerTag(tag: com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorTag) {
            if (tag.name.isBlank()) return
            if (tag.name.startsWith("!")) return
            if (tag.category != TagCategory.ITEM && tag.category != TagCategory.HEALTH) return
            if (tag.value > 0) result.add(tag.name)
        }

        for (scene in scenes) {
            for (tag in scene.tags) registerTag(tag)
            for (choice in scene.choices) {
                for (tag in choice.tags) registerTag(tag)
            }
        }

        return result
    }

    private fun collectEstablishableNames(
        scenes: List<EditorScene>,
        initialState: PlayerState?
    ): Set<String> {
        val result = mutableSetOf<String>()

        fun registerName(rawName: String) {
            if (rawName.isBlank()) return
            if (rawName.startsWith("!")) return
            result.add(rawName)
        }

        for (scene in scenes) {
            for (tag in scene.tags) {
                registerName(tag.name)
            }
            for (choice in scene.choices) {
                for (tag in choice.tags) {
                    registerName(tag.name)
                }
            }
        }

        initialState?.flags?.forEach { registerName(it) }

        initialState?.stats?.forEach { (name, value) ->
            if (value != 0) registerName(name)
        }

        return result
    }

    /**
     * Извлекает имя флага из условия has_X / !has_X.
     * Возвращает null, если условие не про флаг (например, "health >= 50").
     */
    private fun extractHasFlagName(condition: String): String? {
        return when {
            condition.startsWith("!has_") -> condition.removePrefix("!has_").trim().ifEmpty { null }
            condition.startsWith("has_") -> condition.removePrefix("has_").trim().ifEmpty { null }
            else -> null
        }
    }

    /**
     * Моделирует прохождение читалки:
     * - из каждой сцены доступны все choice-таргеты, условие которых потенциально выполнимо:
     *   * null → выполнимо всегда
     *   * has_X → выполнимо, если X в establishable (где-то устанавливается)
     *   * !has_X → выполнимо, если X не в establishable (никогда не устанавливается)
     *   * health >= N / health < N → считаем потенциально выполнимым (значения могут измениться)
     * - если у сцены нет выборов → переход к первой сцене следующей главы
     */
    private fun computeReachable(
        scenes: List<EditorScene>,
        establishable: Set<String>
    ): Set<String> {
        if (scenes.isEmpty()) return emptySet()

        val chapterGroups = buildChapterGroups(scenes)
        val sceneToChapterIdx = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()
        chapterGroups.forEachIndexed { idx, group ->
            group.forEach { sceneToChapterIdx[it.uid] = idx }
        }

        val uidById = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
        scenes.forEach { if (it.id.isNotEmpty()) uidById[it.id] = it.uid }
        val sceneByUid = scenes.associateBy { it.uid }

        val reachable = mutableSetOf<String>()
        val queue = ArrayDeque<String>()
        val startUid = scenes.first().uid
        reachable.add(startUid)
        queue.addLast(startUid)

        while (queue.isNotEmpty()) {
            val currentUid = queue.removeFirst()
            val current = sceneByUid[currentUid] ?: continue

            for (choice in current.choices) {
                val targetUid = uidById[choice.nextSceneId] ?: continue

                val cond = choice.conditionTag.trim()
                if (!isConditionPotentiallySatisfiable(cond, establishable)) {
                    continue
                }

                if (targetUid !in reachable) {
                    reachable.add(targetUid)
                    queue.addLast(targetUid)
                }
            }

            if (current.choices.isEmpty()) {
                val currentChapterIdx = sceneToChapterIdx[currentUid] ?: continue
                val nextChapterIdx = currentChapterIdx + 1
                if (nextChapterIdx < chapterGroups.size) {
                    val nextUid = chapterGroups[nextChapterIdx].first().uid
                    if (nextUid !in reachable) {
                        reachable.add(nextUid)
                        queue.addLast(nextUid)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return reachable
    }

    /**
     * Пессимистичная проверка: может ли это условие когда-либо выполниться?
     * - пустое → да
     * - has_X → только если X где-то устанавливается
     * - !has_X → только если X нигде не устанавливается (никогда не появится)
     * - health >= N / < → да (значения могут измениться)
     */
    private fun isConditionPotentiallySatisfiable(
        condition: String,
        establishable: Set<String>
    ): Boolean {
        if (condition.isEmpty()) return true

        val flagName = extractHasFlagName(condition)
        if (flagName != null) {
            val isNegated = condition.startsWith("!has_")
            return if (isNegated) {
                flagName !in establishable
            } else {
                flagName in establishable
            }
        }

        // Условия на статы — оптимистично считаем выполнимыми
        return true
    }

    /** Тот же алгоритм группировки, что и в buildAdventure(). */
    private fun buildChapterGroups(scenes: List<EditorScene>): List<List<EditorScene>> {
        val groups = mutableListOf<List<EditorScene>>()
        var current = mutableListOf<EditorScene>()
        for (scene in scenes) {
            current.add(scene)
            if (scene.isChapterEnd || scene == scenes.last()) {
                groups.add(current.toList())
                current = mutableListOf()
            }
        }
        if (current.isNotEmpty()) groups.add(current)
        return groups
    }
}

FILE: docs/checklist-tracker.md
